We pair the enthusiasm of an industry disruptor with the experience of a longtime leader. Our team of 11,000+ colleagues from around the globe are vital to our success and the reason we’re able to push boundaries in pursuit of better human health.</span><span> </span></p><p></p><p>Find your future at Revvity&nbsp;</p><p></p><p><b>Role summary</b></p><p>We are looking for a hands-on Principal DevOps Engineer to lead the design and implementation of our next-generation CI/CD architecture for platform-based product development. This role is focused on software build and release automation, scalable delivery pipelines, infrastructure as code, packaging, deployment, observability and integration of development workflows with IT, CloudOps and security toolchains. Security automation is an important part of the role, but the primary focus is efficient, scalable and reliable software delivery across Windows, Linux, cloud and instrument-hosted environments.</p><p></p><p><b>You will</b></p><ul><li>Lead the design and implementation of modern CI/CD architecture for platform-based software development across R&amp;D.</li><li>Define, implement and continuously improve scalable build, release, packaging and deployment automation for Windows, Linux and AWS-based software systems.</li><li>Work closely with software engineers to create efficient and maintainable build systems for C/C++, C# and Python projects.</li><li>Design and implement infrastructure as code and environment automation using Terraform and AWS services.</li><li>Drive standardization and automation of configuration management, package management, artifact management and software delivery processes.</li><li>Collaborate effectively with IT, CloudOps, and security teams to integrate development workflows into the corporate infrastructure and security toolchain.</li><li>Modernize and optimize legacy Jenkins-based CI/CD while helping establish the target AWS-based delivery architecture.</li><li>Implement and improve monitoring, metrics, alerting, and automated engineering reporting for build, test, release and deployment processes.</li><li>Design and maintain software packaging and installation solutions, including Windows installers, Linux packages, and deployable system images.</li><li>Support third-party software lifecycle management, including software license tracking, dependency upgrades, version planning and integration into controlled build environments.</li><li>Enable secure and efficient automation of SAST, SCA, DAST, artifact scanning and related controls as part of CI/CD.</li><li>Contribute to long-term DevOps operating model, release engineering practices and delivery governance across platform and product teams.</li></ul><p></p><p><b>Qualification requirements</b></p><ul><li>MS in STEM or equivalent practical experience.</li><li>10+ years of experience in DevOps, build and release engineering, CI/CD, infrastructure automation or software delivery engineering roles.</li><li>Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD architectures for complex multi-language software environments.</li><li>Strong hands-on expertise with Jenkins.</li><li>Strong hands-on expertise with AWS services relevant to CI/CD and software delivery, especially S3, CodeArtifact and related automation and deployment services.</li><li>Deep understanding of CI and CD concepts, build orchestration, release engineering, artifact lifecycle, traceability and deployment strategies.</li><li>Expert-level experience with Infrastructure as Code, especially Terraform.</li><li>Strong experience with Git and GitHub-based workflows.</li><li>Strong experience with build systems and packaging for C/C++, C# and Python projects, including tools such as MSBuild, CMake, make, pip/poetry and related packaging mechanisms.</li><li>Proven experience with Windows installers, Linux packaging and software deployment automation.</li><li>Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell and/or Bash.</li><li>Solid understanding of configuration management, package management, dependency management and software supply chain concepts.</li><li>Experience integrating engineering workflows into enterprise security toolchains, including SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets scanning and artifact or dependency scanning.</li><li>Experience with monitoring, observability and engineering reporting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, SonarQube, or similar platforms.</li><li>Strong collaboration skills and ability to work effectively across R&amp;D, IT, CloudOps, QA and security teams.</li></ul><p></p><p><b>Strong plus</b></p><ul><li>Experience with hybrid environments spanning developer workstations, instruments, on-premise systems and AWS cloud.</li><li>Experience with software license management and third-party component governance.</li><li>Experience with artifact repositories, binary/package lifecycle management and controlled upgrade processes.</li><li>Experience with deployment image creation, including ISO-based or image-based delivery concepts.</li><li>Experience contributing to MLOps or DataOps workflows.</li></ul></div>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United Kingdom
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://runware.ai">http://runware.ai</a>
</p>

<strong>Description</strong><br><p>Runware is building the API layer for the next generation of AI products. Our platform gives teams fast, reliable access to real-time inference across thousands of models through a single flexible API. We help customers build and scale media generation products with better performance, lower cost, and less operational complexity.</p><p>Behind this is an infrastructure platform built for speed, reliability, and GPU scale. New models launch constantly. Customer traffic can grow quickly. Performance matters at every layer.</p><p>We are looking for a Staff/Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate, and scale the infrastructure behind Runware’s global AI inference platform. You’ll play a critical role in making our systems faster, more resilient, easier to operate, and ready for the next stage of growth.</p><p></p><h3>About the role</h3><p>Runware’s infrastructure is the engine behind some of the fastest-growing AI products in the world. As a Staff/Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll help design, build, and operate the systems that power real-time AI inference across large-scale GPU fleets and a global production platform.</p><p>This is not a traditional DevOps role. You’ll be working at the intersection of bare-metal infrastructure, GPUs, networking, automation, observability, and high-performance distributed systems. Your work will directly shape how quickly we can launch new models, scale customer traffic, recover from failures, and deliver low-latency AI experiences to millions of users.</p><p>You’ll turn complex, hardware-driven infrastructure into reliable, automated, developer-friendly platforms. From provisioning and orchestration to deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and capacity scaling, you’ll help remove friction so engineering teams can move faster without compromising reliability.</p><p>You’ll build the foundations that let Runware scale with confidence: infrastructure that is fast, resilient, observable, secure, and built for the demands of real-time AI.</p><h3>What you’ll do</h3><ul><li>Build and scale the infrastructure that powers real-time AI inference across GPU fleets, bare-metal servers, serverless and containerised production systems</li><li>Help evolve Runware’s platform toward more elastic, on-demand infrastructure that can scale quickly with customer traffic and model demand</li><li>Make Runware faster, more reliable and more resilient by improving the critical paths behind our request entrypoints, inference services, queues, storage, load balancers and networking layer</li><li>Automate the hard parts of infrastructure operations, from provisioning and configuration through to CI/CD, deployment safety, progressive rollouts and rapid rollback</li><li>Build the observability backbone for a high-performance AI platform, with the signals needed to spot issues early, understand capacity and fix problems before customers feel them</li><li>Play a leading role in production operations, incident response, debugging and post-incident improvements, helping us turn operational challenges into a stronger platform</li><li>Strengthen the security and compliance foundations of our infrastructure through patching, secrets management, access controls, hardening, auditability, documentation and repeatable operational processes</li></ul><br><br><strong>Requirements</strong><br><ul><li>Strong experience as a DevOps Engineer, SRE, Infrastructure Engineer, Platform Engineer or similar, with a track record of running production systems at scale</li><li>Deep Linux knowledge and confidence debugging real production issues across networking, storage, performance, services and system behaviour</li><li>Hands-on experience building automation, Infrastructure-as-Code, CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows that make infrastructure safer and easier to operate</li><li>Experience operating high-availability, low-latency or high-throughput platforms where reliability and performance directly affect customers</li><li>Strong networking fundamentals across TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, routing, firewalls, proxies, TLS and HTTP</li><li>A calm and pragmatic approach under pressure, with strong communication, good judgement and a bias toward automation over manual toil</li></ul><h3>Bonus</h3><ul><li>Experience operating GPU infrastructure for AI/ML inference, including NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, GPU monitoring, capacity planning and workload isolation</li><li>Familiarity with inference serving and optimisation frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT, Triton or similar</li></ul><br><br><strong>Benefits</strong><br><p>We’re a remote-first collective, meeting in person twice a year to plan, brainstorm, celebrate wins, and enjoy some face-to-face time. We have core hours for cooperative working and calls, but outside of that your calendar is yours. Work the hours that let you perform at your peak while also building a healthy life.</p><p>Our release cycles are fast and intense, but they’re followed by real downtime. After big pushes we expect the team to unplug, recharge, and come back ready &amp; stronger than ever for the next leap.</p><ul><li> <strong>Generous paid time off</strong>&nbsp;– vacation, sick days, public holidays</li><li> <strong>Meaningful stock options</strong>&nbsp;– share in the upside you create</li><li> <strong>Remote-first setup</strong>&nbsp;– work from home anywhere we can employ you</li><li> <strong>Flexible hours</strong>&nbsp;– own your schedule outside core collaboration blocks</li><li> <strong>Family leave</strong>&nbsp;– paid maternity, paternity, and caregiver time</li><li> <strong>Company retreats</strong>&nbsp;– twice-yearly gatherings in inspiring locations</li></ul><p></p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/runware-staff-devops-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/runware-staff-devops-engineer</a></p>

<div class="job__description body"><div><p><strong>It’s not just about the tech; it’s about the people!</strong></p>
<p>At Career TEAM, we work to “accelerate the human condition.” Working on our state-of-the-edge portal, <em>Career EDGE</em>, you will change lives—and that’s just the beginning! You'll be working with new technologies on enterprise products that serve a diverse population across the U.S. As a founding member of our newly forming team, you'll have the opportunity to grow and shape it as we adeptly traverse the complex digital landscape of generative AI, cloud computing, and cutting-edge technologies.</p>
<p><strong>Specifically, what you will do</strong></p>
<p>You will build amazing things using MongoDB, Next.js, Nest.js, and Node.js, alongside DevOps tools and practices. On any given day, you'll be coding, reviewing, deploying, testing, and iterating—this is our bread and butter. You'll participate in regular Scrum ceremonies while continuously innovating and optimizing for speed, scalability, and security. You'll also help architect systems to ensure high availability and resilience, leveraging AWS services to build scalable cloud solutions.</p>
<p><strong>Key Responsibilities:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Full-Stack Development:</strong> Use technologies like Node.js, MongoDB, Next.js, and Nest.js to develop robust applications.</li>
<li><strong>DevOps and CI/CD Pipelines:</strong> Develop and manage CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and YAML for seamless deployment.</li>
<li><strong>Containerization and Orchestration:</strong> Leverage Docker and Kubernetes for containerization and orchestration of applications.&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Cloud Infrastructure on AWS:</strong> Implement scalable DevOps solutions using AWS services like EC2, S3, Lambda, and RDS.&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Security Best Practices:</strong> Build secure, robust web applications with a strong focus on security standards and protocols.&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Architectural Collaboration:</strong> Work with cross-functional teams to make architectural decisions for system scalability and performance.&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>RESTful Services Development:</strong> Design, develop, test, and deploy RESTful APIs and microservices.&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Infrastructure Automation:</strong> Develop processes for infrastructure automation using Terraform, Jenkins, and Docker.&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Real-Time Problem Solving:</strong> Solve complex problems in real-time, ensuring high performance and reliability.&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Monitoring and Logging:</strong> Implement monitoring and logging solutions to ensure system health and performance.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Ideal Candidate Qualifications:</strong>&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>

</ul>
</li>

&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>

&nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp; &nbsp;</li>

</p>

<div class="externalPosting">
<p><strong>Where you’ll work:</strong></p>
<p>Our flexible, hybrid work model offers the option to work remotely or in the office.</p>
<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p><strong>How you’ll contribute: </strong></p>
<p>This position will be a key member of the Annuity Modeling team. The Annuity Modeling team is responsible for developing and testing Prophet models for new and current annuity products.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>This position will be responsible for Prophet modeling and development for the FA/FIA Prophet model. There will also be opportunities to work on projects that affect the department more broadly, such as Prophet Enterprise usage and Assumptions Management.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>In this role, you’ll get to:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>This role may have the opportunity to manage other students as an introduction to management</li>
<li>This role will be responsible for the projects and timelines for the FA &amp; FIA Prophet model. Involvement encompasses creating and building, updating, enhancing, running, and validating the model.</li>
<li>Analysis of model results, including: reconciliation and attribution of changes, communication of results to management, and detailed documentation</li>
<li>Implement and test new software releases, library updates, new products, new regulatory requirements, and shared table changes in the Prophet environment</li>
<li>Optimize models to follow coding standards and improve performance</li>
<li>Evaluate new features and modeling approaches for use in our models</li>
<li>Stage model inputs using Data Conversion Systems (DCS) and Assumption Manager</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>We’re looking for people who have:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>ASA or near ASA preferred but not required&nbsp;</li>
<li>Currently pursuing an ASA or FSA designation with the Society of Actuaries</li>
<li>Strong computing and programming skills</li>
<li>Strong actuarial and financial skills</li>
<li>Strong communication skills</li>
<li>Can adjust work resources and deadlines in response to changing business priorities&nbsp;</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Research shows some people may not apply for a role if they don’t check all the boxes of a job description. If you don’t check every box listed, that’s okay. We would love to hear from you.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you’ll receive:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Compensation –<em>&nbsp;</em></strong>Base salary ranging from $100,000 - $125,000 plus competitive performance-based incentives determined by company and individual results.</li>
<li><strong>Flexible Work Environment –<em>&nbsp;</em></strong>Work remotely or in the office to better thrive in all areas of life.</li>
<li><strong>Paid Time Off –</strong> Recharge with a minimum of 20 days of paid time off and 16 paid company holidays per calendar year plus paid volunteer time and paid study time.</li>
<li><strong>Financial Health –&nbsp;</strong>Work toward achieving your financial goals through our<strong> </strong>401(k) savings plan with company match (up to 6%) and annual company nondiscretionary contribution (3%), and financial counseling services.</li>
<li><strong>Health and Wellness –&nbsp;</strong>Enjoy competitive medical, vision, and dental plans plus tax-free health savings accounts with potential company contributions up to $1,000 per family.</li>
<li><strong>Family Support –<em>&nbsp;</em></strong>Care for loved ones with up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents, back-up dependent care, dependent care flexible spending account, and up to a $25,000 lifetime maximum during your adoption, infertility, or surrogacy journey.</li>
<li><strong>Life and Disability Support –</strong> Gain access to company-paid basic life insurance and short-term disability insurance.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>The company and your department may occasionally gather in person throughout the year to foster a culture of belonging and promote team building. We’d love for you to join us during those company-wide and department-wide events to help you strengthen connections across the company.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Why join us?</strong></p>
<p>Brighthouse Financial is on a mission to help people achieve financial security. Our company is one of the largest providers of annuities and life insurance in the U.S.,* and we specialize in products designed to help people protect what they’ve earned and ensure it lasts.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We empower employees to collaborate, bring their passion to work, and make an impact. Our inclusive work environment fosters a culture that celebrates diverse backgrounds and experiences. You can find out more about our company culture by visiting brighthousefinancial.com/about-us/careers/.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>We’re one of the largest providers of annuities and life insurance in the U.S.,* and our commitment to being a great place to work has earned us recognition as one of America’s Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek and, locally, one of the Healthiest Employers of Greater Charlotte.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>*Ranked by 2024 admitted assets. Best’s Review®: Top 200 U.S. Life/Health Insurers. AM Best, 2025.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

<h2><strong>About </strong><a href="http://Super.com"><strong>Super.com</strong></a></h2><p>We started <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> to help maximize lives–both the lives of our customers and the lives of our team – so that everyone can experience all that life has to offer. For our employees, our promise is that <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> is more than just a job; it’s an opportunity to unlock one’s potential, where learning is celebrated and impact is realized.</p><p>We are more than a fast-paced, high-growth tech company; we care about our people and take career progression seriously. This is your career and our aim is to supercharge it through the people, the work, and the programs that fuel who we are.</p><p></p><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2><p>We’re hiring a Product Marketing Manager to define how we position, launch, and scale the <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> product portfolio across our membership, fintech, earnings, and travel offerings. Reporting directly to the SVP of Product &amp; Design, this role sits at the intersection of product, design, data, and growth. You’ll own the story of why <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> matters, translating complex products into simple, differentiated narratives that drive adoption, engagement, and retention. If you’re excited by 0‑1 bets, scaling proven products, and building a cohesive portfolio story in a fast-moving environment, this role gives you outsized ownership and visibility.</p><p></p><h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2><p>The Product &amp; Design organization shapes end-to-end product experiences across our core surfaces, partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Research, Data, Brand, and Growth. We are a highly collaborative, data-informed team that works through Mission Aligned Teams (MATs) across Fintech, Earnings, Travel, and our Incubation Hub. We move quickly, test rigorously, and care deeply about quality—from the strategy and positioning down to the last piece of product copy. You’ll join a team that values clear narratives, sharp positioning, and tight product–market–message fit, and that expects Product Marketing to be a strategic partner, not a service function.</p><p></p><h2><strong>What you’ll be working on:</strong></h2><ul><li><p>Own product positioning and messaging for key <a href="http://Super.com">Super.com</a> offerings (e.g., membership, card, earnings, travel), ensuring they are clear, differentiated, and customer-backed.</p></li><li><p>Build and execute go‑to‑market plans for new products, features, and experiments, partnering with GMs, Product, Design, Data, and Growth to drive adoption and revenue.</p></li><li><p>Develop and maintain a cohesive portfolio narrative that ties together our products into a clear, compelling member value proposition across surfaces and channels.</p></li><li><p>Lead customer, competitive, and market insights work to inform product strategy, positioning, pricing/packaging, and roadmap decisions.</p></li><li><p>Partner with Lifecycle/CRM, Performance Marketing, and Brand to ensure message-market fit across ads, landing pages, in‑product surfaces, and lifecycle programs.</p></li><li><p>Define success metrics for launches and campaigns, build measurement plans, and use experimentation and analytics to iterate and scale what works.</p></li><li><p>Create <p>

</p>

<h2>Who We Are</h2><p>Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 32 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.</p><p><strong>Vultr Cares</strong></p><ul><li><p>100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.&nbsp;</p></li><li><p>401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting</p></li><li><p>Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year</p></li><li><p>11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan&nbsp;</p></li><li><p>Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year</p></li><li><p>$500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year</p></li><li><p>Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month</p></li><li><p>Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month</p></li><li><p>Company paid Wellable subscription</p></li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Join Vultr</strong></p><p>Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced NetDevOps Engineer to help us evolve, automate and operate our RoCE-based Ethernet fabrics. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company where you’l bel working at the intersection of network engineering, operations, automation, and observability. Building and operating the tooling and telemetry pipelines that keep the network fabrics fast, deterministic, and reliable at global scale. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team that moves quickly, thinks programmatically and treats networks as software systems</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p><ul><li><p>Automate deployment and operations of large-scale RDMA (RoCEv2) Ethernet fabrics across Vultr data centers.</p></li><li><p>Build Ansible and Python-based frameworks to provision, validate, and remediate underlay and overlay networks.</p></li><li><p>Integrate network automation with Vultr’s source-of-truth systems (NetBox, OpsMill) for intent-driven configuration and validation.</p></li><li><p>Develop telemetry ingestion and correlation pipelines (gNMI, Prometheus, Kafka, custom collectors) for real-time network health and performance metrics.</p></li><li><p>Collaborate with platform, orchestration, and product engineering teams to optimize RDMA performance, PFC/ECN behavior, and path symmetry across fabrics.</p></li><li><p>Implement CI/CD workflows for network configuration changes — validation, pre-checks, and rollbacks.</p></li><li><p>Investigate complex network behaviors across layers — flow hashing, congestion domains, ECMP, and overlay interactions.</p></li><li><p>Contribute to the design of next-generation GPU and AI interconnect fabrics, ensuring seamless integration into Vultr’s global network architecture.</p></li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Qualifications</strong></p><ul><li><p>Solid understanding of modern data center networking: EVPN-VXLAN, BGP, MLAG, QoS, and traffic engineering.</p></li><li><p>Deep familiarity with RoCEv2, RDMA transport tuning, ECN/PFC, and lossless Ethernet design.</p></li><li><p>Strong experience with automation frameworks like Ansible, and languages like Python, Golang, Rust, or PHP</p></li><li><p>Comfort working with telemetry and monitoring stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, ELK, or similar.</p></li><li><p>Previous experience integrating with NetBox, Nautobot, OpsMill or similar for topology and configuration source-of-truth.</p></li><li><p>Familiarity with CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, ArgoCD) for continuous delivery of network automation.</p></li><li><p>Strong Linux networking background, including namespaces, netlink, and system-level debugging.</p></li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p><p>$90,000 - $130,000</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><em>This salary can vary based on location, years of experience, background and skill set.</em></p><h2><strong>Inclusion &amp; Privacy</strong></h2><p>We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.</p><p>We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.</p><p>Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our .</p>

<p></p>
<p>Customer Success at Bask Health is AI-first and customer-obsessed. Work starts in an LLM to clarify intent and context, moves into research and execution, is validated with real patients and partners, and is continuously refined as we learn. AI and self-serve research are default parts of the workflow, not side experiments.</p>
<p>We are looking for Customer Success people who take full ownership of their accounts, treat AI as a real collaborator, and care deeply about the patient and provider experience.</p>
<p>What You'll Do</p>

<li>Work AI-first: Use LLMs as your starting point to draft communications, structure problems, and think through customer needs. Apply your own judgment to refine the output and make it human.</li>
<li>Validate with real customers and iterate: Test your approaches with real patients, providers, and partners. Use what you learn to improve how we serve them — before issues become patterns.</li>
<li>Make automation legible and trustworthy: Help customers understand what Bask's platform is doing on their behalf. Communicate clearly and proactively to build trust while keeping their experience simple.</li>
</ul>
<p>Share AI-native workflows: Document prompts, processes, and workflows that work. Share them across the Customer Success team so we raise the bar together.</p>
<p></p>
<p></p>
<p>In this job, you will:</p>
<ul>
<li>Build strong relationships with Bask's customers and own the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, value realization, engagement strategies, expansion, and renewals</li>
<li>Partner with customer stakeholders to develop custom engagement initiatives that drive user adoption and support the unique needs of their patients</li>
<li>Manage all current customer data</li>
<li>Analyze customer engagement metrics and use them to communicate value, trends, and opportunities with key stakeholders</li>
<li>Deliver program demos, provide insightful technical answers, and recommend creative ways to get the most out of the Bask platform</li>
<li>Finding comfort in working in a fast-paced startup environment</li>
<li>Believing no task is too small and no task is too tall</li>
</ul>
<p></p>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul> <li>7+ years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, or Customer Success at a SaaS organization</li> <li>Experience in e-commerce</li> <li>Experience with large- to enterprise-sized customer book of business</li> <li>Creative problem solver with a determination to succeed</li> <li>Independent and motivated, with the wisdom to seek help where needed</li> <li>An entrepreneur</li> <li>Highly articulate, ability to communicate effectively both when speaking and writing</li> <li>Highly organized, with the ability to juggle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Comfortable collaborating with different teams (product, sales, marketing, etc.)</li> </ul>

<div><p></p><p>At Intapp, the Program Manager is responsible for managing a program of software implementation projects for Intapp’s clients.&nbsp; The Program Manager serves as a primary point of contact for the executive/senior client sponsors and manages interdependencies across all initiatives/projects in the migration program, while ensuring that value is delivered on time and within budget. The Program Manager holds the primary responsibility for program success and customer satisfaction and is a senior, seasoned professional who is adept at leading large teams and strategic programs.</p><p><b>What you will do:</b></p><ul><li><p>Manage and drive a program plan, to include interdependencies across projects, working closely with the project managers, business unit leads and the Migration Program Director.</p></li><li><p>Prepare, plan, and lead program updates to internal stakeholders</p></li><li><p>Become a trusted advisor of the client Intapp sponsor and senior/executive client stakeholders, meeting regularly to garner their feedback, provide them with insight, and to get out in front of and risks and issues as they arise</p></li><li><p>Dive into the details in a “hands on” capacity to assist project managers during critical project phases to ensure that deadlines are met, client expectations are managed, and all risks are mitigated, paving the way for successful delivery</p></li><li><p>Provide management in a matrixed capacity to project managers and Intapp services professionals</p></li><li><p>Manage escalations swiftly with senior client leaders, working with the collective team to develop issue resolutions</p></li><li><p>Negotiate with senior level management (internal and external), as needed, to gain win/win resolutions</p></li><li><p>Identify and match the skills of the project team members with projects, including subcontractors, ensuring that they know and understand their assignments; this includes identifying any resource gaps on the client or Intapp teams</p></li><li><p>Leverage and incorporate innovative methodologies, enablers, and best practices to accelerate delivery and time to value to customer</p></li></ul><p><b>What you will need:</b></p><ul><li><p>3 - 5 years of program direction/management experience in a geo-dispersed, matrixed organization, with a proven track record of delivering a diverse portfolio of software products and solutions for multiple clients simultaneously.</p></li><li><p>A strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and agile methodologies</p></li><li><p>A minimum of 8 years of experience working in a technology-oriented company or functional role. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.</p></li><li><p><b>Support What Matters Most:</b>&nbsp;Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our&nbsp;benefits&nbsp;are designed to care for you and your family.&nbsp; Our family-formation&nbsp;benefits&nbsp;and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.&nbsp;</p></li></ul><p></p><p>Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. <p>

</p>

<h2><strong>About the Job</strong></h2><p></p><p>Palette is a fast-growing startup at the center of the creator economy. Our team of 60+ is working towards defining the standard for talent management and marketing in an era of new media dominated by digital-first entertainers.</p><p></p><p>Our management infrastructure mirrors the depth of attention given to the world’s biggest cultural and entertainment icons, and previously reserved for artists in traditional arenas of entertainment. Today, we serve as the nerve center for a roster of 200+ creators and influencers with a combined following of 500M+ serving over 4.7B impressions monthly on platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and Snapchat. Our creators have starred in Super Bowl commercials, launched national brands, and have been featured in nearly every major publication.</p><p></p><p>Our marketing agency executes strategy for some of the most influential brands and organizations in the world, including: The White House, Amazon and simplehuman. 42% of Americans under the age of 40 are no longer accessible through traditional marketing channels like television – we enable organizations to speak to those audiences. Our marketing team has been recognized with 5 Shorty Impact Awards, and has advised three US Presidents on the future of the internet.</p><p></p><h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2><p></p><p>Palette Media is seeking a Director of Product &amp; Data Innovation to shape the future of how brands and creators connect through data, technology, and insights. This role will serve as the connection between data, product, and client impact—developing proprietary tools, research frameworks, and automation systems that push the boundaries of creator marketing.</p><p></p><p>You’ll lead the evolution of our analytics infrastructure, from survey design and campaign measurement to productizing insights that fuel client strategies. We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy and systems, capable of translating client needs and market trends into actionable, data-backed innovation.</p><p></p><h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2><ul><li><p>Develop and distill the company POV into data-backed industry white papers.</p></li><li><p>Automate and optimize processes such as campaign reporting, and performance tracking to improve efficiency and client outcomes.</p></li><li><p>Work with internal stakeholders and external partners to provide meaningful insights to our clients.</p></li><li><p>Develop analytics infrastructure to measure the effectiveness of creator campaigns, identify trends, and generate actionable insights for clients.</p></li><li><p>Lead the design, development, and launch of proprietary technology products to support creator marketing brand activations</p></li><li><p>Translate client needs and creator trends into innovative tools and data strategies that keep the agency at the forefront of the creator economy.</p></li><li><p>Collaborate with leadership and client-facing teams to ensure adoption and success of tools, insights, and data-driven storytelling.</p></li><li><p>Leverage AI to help further the above goals.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2><ul><li><p>8+ years professional work experience, including at least 4 years of experience at a consultancy or agency-environment.</p></li><li><p>Proven experience building and scaling data-driven products within marketing, media or tech industries.</p></li><li><p>Prior experience with polling, surveys, research methodology.</p></li><li><p>Deep understanding of campaign measurement, and digital marketing trends (creator/influencer or social media marketing experience a plus).</p></li><li><p>Strong technical background, including experience with data platforms, automation, and analytics systems.</p></li><li><p>Leadership experience overseeing product, engineering, and analytics/data science functions.</p></li><li><p>Excellent analytical skills.</p></li><li><p>Thrives in fast-paced environments.</p></li></ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
</p>

<h2>About Assemble</h2><p>Assemble is the AI platform for healthcare’s leadership; helping automate administrative work, streamline workflows, and improve team collaboration to enhance patient care. </p><p>We work closely with nursing and operations leaders to modernize how healthcare teams coordinate work, make decisions, and support each other.</p><p></p><h2>The role</h2><p>We’re hiring our first full-time Product Designer to own the end-to-end experience of the Assemble web app and future companion mobile app.</p><p>You’ll be the design backbone of the team: setting the bar for product quality, building our design system from the ground up, and partnering closely with product and engineering to ship fast in a high-ambiguity environment.</p><p>This role is ideal for someone who is excited to go deep on productivity workflows, loves turning messy problems into simple, elegant interfaces, and is motivated by improving the day-to-day of leaders working in healthcare.</p><p></p><h2>What you’ll do</h2><ul><li><p>Own the product experience across our full web surface and future mobile app – from discovery to shipped product.  </p></li><li><p>Design end-to-end flows for complex productivity workflows (task management, collaboration, automation, analytics, etc.).  </p></li><li><p>Create and evolve Assemble’s design system to enable us to ship with high velocity and quality.  </p></li><li><p>Prototype with modern AI tools like Cursor &amp; Bolt to explore interactions, flows, and lightweight coded prototypes.  </p></li><li><p>Partner tightly with product &amp; engineering to define problems, shape specs, and iterate quickly based on real usage.  </p></li><li><p>Run lean discovery – user interviews, lightweight usability tests, and rapid experiments to validate ideas.  </p></li><li><p>Champion craft &amp; UX quality while still shipping quickly in a startup environment.  </p></li><li><p>Lay the foundations for a future design team, including processes, rituals, and documentation that others can build on.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2>What we’re looking for</h2><ul><li><p>Deeply mission-driven and excited by the idea of making healthcare work better for the people who run it.  </p></li><li><p>Experienced product designer (typically 5–8+ years) with a strong portfolio of impactful work in productivity software.  </p></li><li><p>Demonstrated ability to simplify complex, multi-step workflows into intuitive, delightful experiences.  </p></li><li><p>Experience building or contributing to a design system (Figma libraries, tokens, component standards, usage guidelines).   </p></li><li><p>Comfortable working from problem definition to polished UI – strategy, IA, interaction design, visual design, and prototyping.  </p></li><li><p>Hands-on experience using modern AI tooling (e.g. Cursor, Bolt, or similar) to speed up exploration, prototyping, or implementation.  </p></li><li><p>Comfortable working quickly in high ambiguity: you’re comfortable with vague problem spaces, shifting priorities, and 0→1 product work. Speed enables quality through tighter iteration cycles.  </p></li><li><p>Strong product sense: you think in terms of impact, trade-offs, and user outcomes, not just visual polish.  </p></li><li><p>Excellent communicator who can tell the story of your design decisions to both technical and non-technical teammates.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2>Bonus points</h2><ul><li><p>Experience designing for healthcare, frontline workforces, or operational tools.  </p></li><li><p>Familiarity with mobile design patterns (iOS/Android) and designing with Shadcn components.  </p></li><li><p>Experience as an early design hire or working in a seed/Series A startup.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2>How we work</h2><ul><li><p>Fast, iterative shipping – we bias toward small, frequent releases and learning from real usage.  </p></li><li><p>Low-ego collaboration – good ideas can come from anywhere; we debate, then commit.  </p></li><li><p>Ownership – as the first designer, you’ll help define how design shows up at Assemble.  </p></li><li><p>Hybrid async/sync communication – thoughtful documentation, plus regular real-time design jams.</p></li></ul><h2></h2>

      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> BR
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://trinca.com">http://trinca.com</a>
</p>

<div><p><strong>Na TRINCA, a gente não preenche vagas. A gente convida pessoas para construir o que vem a seguir.</strong></p>
<p>Dados são a matéria-prima de qualquer decisão que importa. Mas dado bruto sem arquitetura, sem pipeline e sem contexto de negócio não vale nada. Se você sabe transformar volume em valor, e quer fazer isso em um dos setores mais intensivos em dados do Brasil, essa vaga pode ser o seu próximo grande desafio.</p>
<p>Aqui você vai ser <strong>a engenharia por trás das decisões</strong>: responsável por construir e evoluir a infraestrutura de dados de uma plataforma de seguros de grande escala, garantindo que as informações certas cheguem às pessoas certas, no momento certo.</p>
<h2>✨ Sua missão na TRINCA</h2>
<p>Você vai atuar como peça central da jornada de dados de uma plataforma de seguros em expansão com governança crescente e demanda real por qualidade de dado.<br>Sua missão é garantir que os pipelines sejam robustos, os modelos sejam escaláveis e o time de negócio tenha acesso a informações confiáveis para navegar com segurança.</p>
<p>Você vai ser <strong>dono da engenharia de dados end-to-end</strong>: da ingestão ao insight, passando por arquitetura, orquestração e qualidade.</p>
<p>Tudo isso no nosso jeito de trabalhar: <strong>direto, humano, colaborativo e com impacto real.</strong></p>
<h2>O que você vai construir no dia a dia</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Pipelines de dados:</strong> projetar, implementar e manter pipelines robustos e escaláveis, integrando dados de APIs, sistemas internos e fontes externas com foco em volume e confiabilidade.</li>
<li><strong>Arquitetura e modelagem:</strong> desenvolver e evoluir modelos de dados em Data Lakehouse (Delta Lake), estruturando camadas que sustentem análises complexas e o crescimento da plataforma.</li>
<li><strong>Orquestração e automação:</strong> configurar e operar ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Dagster ou similares) para garantir que processos rodem com qualidade e pontualidade.</li>
<li><strong>Qualidade e governança:</strong> contribuir para a construção de um dicionário de dados unificado, aplicar práticas de CI/CD e controle de versão nos pipelines, e assegurar integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados.</li>
<li><strong>Parceria com negócio:</strong> colaborar com times de produto, analistas e cientistas de dados para traduzir perguntas de negócio em análises concretas e identificar oportunidades de melhoria.</li>
<li><strong>Inovação em dados:</strong> apoiar iniciativas de Machine Learning e modelos preditivos, contribuindo para a antecipação de tendências e a otimização de operações.</li>
</ul>
<h2>O que buscamos em você</h2>
<h3>Requisitos essenciais</h3>
<ul>
<li>Experiência comprovada em Engenharia de Dados, com histórico de construção e manutenção de pipelines robustos e escaláveis em ambientes de grande volume.</li>
<li>Experiência com <strong>Databricks</strong> e/ou outras plataformas analíticas distribuídas, incluindo arquiteturas Data Lakehouse e Delta Lake.</li>
<li>Proficiência avançada em <strong>SQL</strong> e domínio de bancos relacionais e não relacionais (ex.: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Cassandra).</li>
<li>Domínio de <strong>Python com PySpark</strong> e frameworks de Big Data como Apache Spark ou Apache Flink.</li>
<li>Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração de pipelines, como <strong>Apache Airflow</strong> ou Dagster.</li>
<li>Experiência com ambientes de nuvem (<strong>Azure, AWS ou GCP</strong>) e serviços de armazenamento distribuído (Azure Data Lake Storage, AWS S3, GCS).</li>
<li>Conhecimento de práticas de <strong>CI/CD e controle de versão com Git/GitHub</strong> aplicadas a pipelines de dados.</li>
<li>Familiaridade com ingestão de dados em tempo real via <strong>Kafka, Kinesis</strong> ou similares.</li>
<li><strong>Uso real de IA no trabalho:</strong> cases concretos em que você aplicou IA para ganhar velocidade, qualidade ou consistência em engenharia de dados. Por exemplo: uso de LLMs para gerar ou revisar transformações SQL, automação de documentação de pipelines, detecção de anomalias com IA ou otimização de queries com sugestões de IA. Não basta “já usei ChatGPT”.</li>
<li>Alinhamento real com nossos valores: <strong>Conecte-se de verdade | Assuma os desafios | Entregue com orgulho</strong>.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Diferenciais que brilham os olhos</h3>
<ul>
<li>Experiência com ferramentas de BI como <strong>Power BI, Tableau ou Looker</strong> para construção de dashboards e relatórios.</li>
<li>Experiência com modelos preditivos e implementação de Machine Learning em ambiente de produção.</li>
<li>Certificação <strong>Databricks Data Engineer Associate</strong> e/ou <strong>Azure DP-203</strong>.</li>
<li>Experiência no setor de seguros ou em plataformas financeiras de alto volume.</li>
<li>Inglês.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Como é o seu jeito de ser (e fazer)</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Assume os desafios:</strong> quando um pipeline quebra em produção ou uma fonte de dados muda sem aviso, você não espera o problema se resolver sozinho. Vai lá, entende a causa raiz e age.</li>
<li><strong>Se conecta de verdade:</strong> sabe que engenharia de dados só faz sentido quando o time de negócio consegue usar o que você entrega. Ouve antes de construir, e comunica o que é possível sem jargão desnecessário.</li>
<li><strong>Entrega com orgulho:</strong> não solta pipeline sem teste, não documenta “depois”, não empurra problema para frente. Qualidade e integridade são inegociáveis para você.</li>
<li>Tem curiosidade genuína para se manter atualizada com as evoluções do ecossistema de dados e tecnologias analíticas, trazendo o que aprende para o trabalho do dia a dia.</li>
<li>Consegue gerenciar projetos de ponta a ponta com autonomia real, da concepção à implementação, sem depender de direcionamento constante.</li>
</ul>
<p>Modelo de contratação <strong>PJ</strong>, com autonomia real e trabalho <strong>remoto</strong>.</p>
<h2>Por que a TRINCA?</h2>
<p>Porque aqui você não entra para “tocar processo”.<br>Você entra para <strong>construir a fundação de dados de uma plataforma de seguros em escala real e preparar o time para o que vem a seguir</strong>.</p>
<p>Se você quer fazer parte de um lugar onde <strong>pessoas importam de verdade</strong>, onde tecnologia é meio e não fim, e onde cada entrega carrega propósito, <strong>vem construir com a gente.</strong></p>
<p>👉 <strong>We Build What’s Next. E queremos você nessa construção.</strong></p></div>

      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> BR

</p>

<div><h3>Nosso time de Product Marketing</h3>
<p>O time de Product Marketing da Nuvemshop atua de forma transversal, conectando estratégia, produto e mercado para impulsionar a adoção das nossas soluções. Nessa posição, o foco é a Marketing Suite — produtos de Marketing Automation, Ads e Geração de Tráfego que ajudam lojistas a atrair, converter e fidelizar clientes. Seu papel é garantir que esses produtos tenham posicionamento claro, argumentos que chegam na ponta comercial e adoção em escala.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>O tamanho do seu desafio</h3>
<p>Como Analista Sênior de Product Marketing, você será a ponte entre produto e mercado — com foco direto em resultado comercial. Isso significa trabalhar de perto com Inside Sales e CS para garantir que os times tenham o que precisam para vender e reter, e com CRM para construir jornadas que geram demanda e adoção. Posicionamento e GTM existem aqui para alimentar execução, não como fim em si mesmos.</p>
<ul>
<li>Ser a referência de produto para Inside Sales e CS — traduzindo diferenciais técnicos em argumentos que chegam na ponta e realmente são usados;</li>
<li>Construir e manter materiais de enablement que evoluem com velocidade a partir do feedback dos times comerciais</li>
<li>Identificar gaps de performance nos times comerciais usando análise de funil e dados de CRM;</li>
<li>Colaborar com CRM na construção de jornadas, campanhas de geração de demanda e estratégias de segmentação;</li>
<li>Manter o posicionamento da Marketing Suite atualizado frente à concorrência no LATAM, apoiando lançamentos com GTM claro e mensagens por público e canal.</li>
</ul>
<h3>O que buscamos</h3>
<ul>
<li>Experiência sólida em Product Marketing com atuação próxima a times comerciais — Inside Sales, CS ou equivalente;</li>
<li>Desenvoltura real com IA no dia a dia — pesquisa, escrita, análise, automação — e interesse genuíno em ir além do uso básico;</li>
<li>Capacidade de construir materiais de enablement que chegam na ponta: não só bem feitos, mas usados;</li>
<li>Habilidade analítica para conectar dados de mercado, feedback comercial e comportamento de cliente em decisões concretas;</li>
<li>Experiência com CRM e campanhas de geração de demanda;</li>
<li>Autonomia para gerenciar múltiplos stakeholders e prioridades simultaneamente.</li>
</ul>
<h4>São diferenciais</h4>
<ul>
<li>Experiência com e-commerce ou SaaS B2B voltado a PMEs;</li>
<li>Experiência com automações e fluxos com IA — agentes, prompts estruturados, integrações;</li>
<li>Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de marketing ou plataformas de Ads;</li>
<li>Familiaridade com metodologias de discovery e validação de produto;</li>
<li>Espanhol intermediário ou avançado.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>Nosso processo</h3>
<p>Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o time de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>O que temos para você</h3>
<ul>
<li>Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;</li>
<li>Flash Benefícios: Plataforma que reúne vale alimentação, vale refeição e outras categorias como educação, entretenimento, cultura, saúde, bem-estar, auxílio home office e muito mais;</li>
<li>Aulas de espanhol semanais gratuitas;</li>
<li>Totalpass: As melhores redes de parcerias para atividades físicas, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e qualidade do sono, com diversos planos disponíveis;</li>
<li>Descontos nos cursos da Coderhouse;</li>
<li>Auxílio creche para crianças de até 5 anos;</li>
<li>Licença de família estendida para 21 dias corridos para pessoas não grávidas ou adotantes. A licença maternidade é de 4 meses e a licença parental de 21 dias. O benefício também vale para famílias que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos;</li>
<li>Além das férias, temos uma semana de descanso para recarregar as energias no final/começo do ano;</li>
<li>Uma Nuvemshop gratuita para você ou pessoa próxima;</li>
<li>Somos #remotefirst - o que significa que damos prioridade ao trabalho remoto dentro do país de contratação, sempre que a função permitir;</li>
<li>E um ambiente de desafio contínuo, propósito e protagonismo — aqui você é livre para pensar grande e ter atitude gigante.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>Política de Privacidade de Dados</h3>
<p>A Nuvemshop está comprometida em proteger a privacidade e garantir a segurança dos dados pessoais das pessoas candidatas às vagas que ofertamos.</p>
<p>Para dar seguimento com a sua candidatura, teremos acesso a alguns dados pessoais seus e gostaríamos de repassar algumas informações antes de você continuar. Utilizaremos tais dados para conduzirmos os processos que envolvem o recrutamento e a seleção. Além disso, cuidamos dos seus dados pessoais de forma muita séria e só os compartilhamos com quem realmente precisa. Por fim, somente iremos mantê-los em nosso sistema pelo tempo realmente necessário.</p>
<p>Para saber mais sobre a forma pela qual tratamos seus dados, inclusive dos seus direitos previstos em lei, basta acessar a nossa&nbsp;<a href="https://www.nuvemshop.com.br/politica-de-privacidade">Política de Privacidade</a>.</p></div>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Spain
</p>

<p><strong>About the Project:</strong><br>Yei Finance is a decentralized, non-custodial money market protocol built on the Sei network, offering innovative and flexible financial solutions. Users benefit from competitive yield, can access over-collateralized or flash loans, and manage risk with advanced tools—all leveraging Sei’s speed and efficiency.</p><p></p><p>Clovis is the latest product by Yei Finance, achieving over $400M TVL at its peak, $5.5M in protocol revenue over the past year, and standing as the largest protocol on Sei. Yei also pioneered the first lending-boosted DEX on Sei, with YeiSwap compounding YeiLend yields to drive $230M+ monthly trading volume and $147M in cross-chain bridge flow. Now, Clovis will expand this model across multiple chains, aiming to become DeFi’s cross-chain prime brokerage layer, supported by top-tier partnerships.</p><p></p><p><strong>Who We Are:</strong></p><ul><li><p>A team of builders from leading Web3 organizations, including AAVE, Wormhole, Venus Labs, OKX, and more</p></li><li><p>Backed by investors such as Outlier Ventures, Manifold, DWF Ventures, and the Sei Foundation</p></li><li><p>Partnered with industry leaders like Circle, OKX Wallet, Binance Wallet, Frax, Stargate, and others</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>The Opportunity</strong><br>As the Product Manager for Clovis, you will own the full product lifecycle—discovery, design, execution, and growth—across Clovis’ modules: Clovis Market, Exchange, Transport, and Vault. You’ll operate at the intersection of engineering, design, data, business, and community, helping scale a platform that’s shaping the future of cross-chain DeFi.</p><p></p><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Define and drive the long-term product vision, strategy, and quarterly roadmaps for Clovis.</p></li><li><p>Collaborate with engineering and design teams to deliver seamless cross-chain lending, liquidity, and asset management experiences.</p></li><li><p>Conduct market and user research to map journeys, identify pain points, and ensure product-market fit.</p></li><li><p>Draft clear user stories, technical specifications, and product documentation that empower engineering and protocol teams.</p></li><li><p>Coordinate engineering sprints and ensure timely execution across cross-functional teams (frontend, backend, smart contracts, data, design, risk).</p></li><li><p>Work with data teams to set up dashboards, monitor product performance (e.g., TVL, user retention, transaction success), and propose actionable improvements.</p></li><li><p>Collaborate with risk teams to model economic implications, set protocol parameters, and maintain robust guardrails.</p></li><li><p>Cultivate partnerships, support integrations, and act as a Clovis advocate at industry and community events.</p></li><li><p>Oversee product releases, manage testing/QA processes, and own internal product excellence initiatives.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p><ul><li><p><strong>Startup-Oriented:</strong> Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments and taking ownership from day one.</p></li><li><p><strong>Mission-Driven:</strong> Motivated by building innovative DeFi products.</p></li><li><p><strong>Collaborative:</strong> Communicates clearly and works effectively across both synchronous and asynchronous teams.</p></li><li><p><strong>Product-Quality Focused:</strong> Cares deeply about user experience and the details that make a product exceptional.</p></li><li><p><strong>Autonomous:</strong> Able to manage your own time, priorities, and outcomes in a fully remote setup.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Qualifications:</strong></p><ul><li><p>3+ years in product management with experience in DeFi or blockchain.</p></li><li><p>Strong understanding of lending, DEXs, cross-chain bridging, liquidity routing, and risk frameworks.</p></li><li><p>Proven record of shipping and scaling complex products.</p></li><li><p>Skilled in structured problem solving, research, and clear documentation.</p></li><li><p>Experience collaborating alongside engineering/design, and writing technical specifications.</p></li><li><p>Familiarity with data tools (e.g., SQL, Dune, Flipside, internal dashboards).</p></li><li><p>Excellent communication skills—capable of simplifying complex topics for diverse audiences.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Nice-to-haves:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Experience creating wireframes, process maps, and user flows.</p></li><li><p>Prior work in a remote or globally distributed team.</p></li><li><p>Contributions to open-source projects and/or DeFi ecosystems.</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Offer:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Competitive salary and token allocation</p></li><li><p>Fully remote setup with autonomy and flexible hours</p></li><li><p>Direct opportunity to build products from 0→1 at scale</p></li></ul><p></p><p><strong>Process:</strong></p><ul><li><p>Recruiter Screen</p></li><li><p>Hiring Manager Call</p></li><li><p>Technical Round</p></li><li><p>Final Interview with the Founder</p></li></ul>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City
</p>

<h1>About the Company</h1><p>Made’s mission is to help homeowners save time, money, and stress. It starts with <strong>Made Card</strong> - a credit card designed specifically for homeowners, with unmatched rewards on mortgage payments, home improvements, utilities, and essential purchases. Each swipe powers a personalized home management platform where users can manage home systems &amp; appliances, stay ahead on upkeep, and get help - from AI-driven guidance to in-person services - exactly when they need it most. By bringing together financial tools, data, and trusted professionals, we give people more control, more savings, and more time to enjoy the place they call home.</p><p>We’re partnered with <strong>leading national players in the residential homeownership space</strong> - from mortgage lenders to home services providers - embedding Made into the key moments of the homeowner journey. These partnerships let us reach millions of households across the country and deliver meaningful benefits to homeowners.</p><p>Backed by top investors like<strong> Village Global, Jump Capital, Recharge Capital, </strong>and <strong>Soma Capital, </strong>our leadership team brings deep fintech, mortgage, and credit card experience from <strong>Ramp, Bain Capital, JP Morgan Chase, American Express, </strong>and <strong>Morgan Stanley</strong>. We’re building the financial and engagement platform for the next generation of homeowners - one that puts the homeowner at the center, and redefines what it means to feel at home.</p><p></p><h1>About the Role</h1><p>We’re looking for a <strong>Product Designer</strong> to create intuitive, elegant, and user-friendly experiences across the Made Card and homeowner platform. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, and marketing to bring designs from concept to launch — shaping the look, feel, and usability of our core product while contributing to our design system and brand identity.</p><p></p><h1>What You’ll Do</h1><ul><li><p>Design end-to-end user experiences across the Made Card and homeowner platform.</p></li><li><p>Translate product requirements and user research into wireframes, prototypes, and polished designs.</p></li><li><p>Collaborate with product and engineering to ensure designs are implemented with quality and consistency.</p></li><li><p>Contribute to the development and maintenance of our design system.</p></li><li><p>Support marketing by aligning visuals and creative assets with the product’s identity.</p></li><li><p>Conduct usability testing and iterate based on insights and feedback.</p></li><li><p>Advocate for the user at every stage of the product development process.</p></li></ul><p></p><h1>Ideal Background</h1><ul><li><p><strong>3–5+ years of product design experience</strong>, ideally in consumer fintech or high-growth startups.</p></li><li><p>Strong portfolio showcasing user-centered design, UI/UX excellence, and design systems.</p></li><li><p>Experience collaborating cross-functionally with product and engineering teams.</p></li><li><p>Skilled with modern design tools like Figma and comfortable with rapid prototyping.</p></li></ul><p><em>We understand that not everyone comes from a traditional background. If you are a rockstar with a non-traditional path, we'd love to talk to you!</em></p><p></p><h1>Nice to Have</h1><ul><li><p>Experience in fintech, proptech, or real estate platforms.</p></li><li><p>Exposure to brand or marketing design in addition to product UI/UX.</p></li><li><p>Motion design or creative storytelling skills.</p></li><li><p>Personal passion for credit cards, rewards, or home design.</p></li></ul><p></p><h1>Why Join Made Now</h1><p>You’ll be an early designer at Made, shaping the user experience of a product redefining homeownership. This is a rare opportunity to have a direct hand in both the product and design culture as the company scales.</p><p></p><h1>Benefits</h1><ul><li><p><strong>Base Compensation Band:</strong> $120,000–$140,000 (determined by experience, qualifications, and location)</p></li><li><p><strong>Compensation:</strong> Competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401k plan</p></li><li><p><strong>Health &amp; Well-being:</strong> We’ll invest in your physical and mental well-being with comprehensive medical, dental, &amp; vision benefits</p></li><li><p><strong>Grow Together:</strong> Company-wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning &amp; development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360 degree feedback</p></li><li><p><strong>Mortgage Benefit:</strong> Receive up to $25,000 toward closing costs of a new mortgage via our mortgage partners</p></li><li><p><strong>Play Together:</strong> Quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners!</p></li><li><p><strong>Generous Time Off:</strong> Flexible paid time off, sick days, and 11 company holidays</p></li></ul><p></p><p><em>Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from </em><a href="http://madecard.com"><em>madecard.com</em></a><em> emails. We won't ever be asking for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to </em><a href="mailto:talent@madecard.com"><em>talent@madecard.com</em></a><em> if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.</em></p><p><br><em>Made Card is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Made Card makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.</em></p><p></p>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5466/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New York City
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://sanctuary.computer">https://sanctuary.computer</a>
</p>

<p>We are&nbsp;<strong><a href="https://usb.club/">USB Club</a></strong>&nbsp;and we are hiring looking for a multi-faceted design engineer to help us push forward our sneaker net for designers, artists, DJs, writers, musicians, researchers, engineers.</p>
<p><a href="https://garden3d.notion.site/Part-Time-Design-Engineer-Contract-365131fea2c78067b2cdc9f07bd46e49?source=copy_link"><strong>Original Job posting link here</strong></a></p>
<h3>Responsibilities</h3>
<p>Ideally you are someone who can both design and code, with an acute understanding of the cultural, design, artist, music and research spaces.</p>
<h3>Product Roadmapping, Research &amp; Strategy</h3>
<p>USB Club offers a lot of opportunity and potential, whether that's →</p>
<ul>
<li>the ability to access the network on the web in read-only or entry-level modes for folks who don't yet have their USB;</li>
<li>the ability to bring your own USB or bless your existing USB with privileges to access the network and serve as a USB club key;</li>
<li>the ability for artists to sell bespoke USBs with their own custom content, reaching their loyalists and superfans, and building back-channel secret networks to share their in-progress and impromptu work;</li>
<li>or growing the platform more into a cloud backup system for DJs and touring musicians to ensure that their work is well preserved;</li>
<li>or building integrations with are.na and other knowledge graph platforms so that files saved on USB can be accessible everywhere and vice versa;</li>
</ul>
<p>We see the product development and iteration of the next chapter of USB Club as one of the more exciting and expansive parts of this role. We have some opinions about where to start but we expect the right person in this role to be someone who can build upon our vision and help realize their own ideas to the highest degree.</p>
<h3>Product &amp; Web Design</h3>
<p><strong>USB Club</strong>&nbsp;ships a MacOS desktop app &amp; iOS app that you can access when you own one of our USBs. You use the desktop app to share files and collect files from other people, both onto your USB and more generally on the network.</p>
<p>You can think of it kinda like Limewire or a torrenting platform of the early 00’s. Something that happens behind the scenes, something where culture moves silently - if you know, you know.</p>
<h3>Engineering</h3>
<p>Our desktop app is an Electron app, our iOS app is a true native app. Our website is in Vue (although we’ll likely move to Next.js soon), and our API is in Typescript on PostgresQL.</p>
<p>We have some dashboards in Retool, and we integrate with Typeform &amp; Airtable.</p>
<p>While we’ll have the support of Sanctuary Computer when necessary, we’re hoping this individual can hold their own in the code, and confidently ship production-grade features without much hand holding.</p>
<h3>Social, Posters, Campaigns &amp; Messaging</h3>
<p>A big part of USB Club is the posters, campaigns, and general messaging strategies that we put onto the internet. A big part of what we do is to build culture around the network. Not only should we be thinking about the product as something that can be improved and more accessible and more utilitarian but also as something where culture happens behind the scenes.</p>
<h3>Time &amp; Compensation</h3>
<p>Compensation for this role will be on an hourly basis (rates discussed via email, pending seniority and ability). The hourly rate here is&nbsp;<strong>$40 - $75/hr</strong>,</p>
<p>For now we expect that this is&nbsp;<strong>not a full-time role</strong>, although it will likely grow to in that direction. We expect that over the next 2 - 3 months a commitment of around 20 - 25 hours a week would suffice.</p>
<h3>Apply Directly Here</h3>
<p>We see this role as a good starter project for starting to join garden3d, and work more closely with&nbsp;<strong><a href="https://xxix.co/">XXIX</a></strong>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<strong><a href="https://www.sanctuary.computer/">Sanctuary Computer</a></strong>&nbsp;our client services business, across all of our client projects.</p>
<p>USB Club is an internal and cultural project so it's a really good place to get started working together, but we’d love to frame this as the start to a longer and more involved relationship, if that’s of interest!</p>
<p>If you’re interested in this role or others, please apply&nbsp;and select “<strong>USB Club Design Engineer</strong>” (among other roles you might be interested in!)</p>
<p>Kindly submit a complete and thoughtful application, including relevant links that help verify your work experience and identity. Applications with missing or insufficient information will not move forward in the review process.</p>
<p>Our team carefully reviews every complete submission, and we truly appreciate the time and effort you put into applying!</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/garden3d-design-engineer-part-time">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/garden3d-design-engineer-part-time</a></p>
</description>

<div><p><strong>Conheça nossa cultura:</strong></p>
<p>Somos movidos pela inovação. Nossas soluções tecnológicas estão&nbsp; transformando a vida de milhões de pessoas.</p>
<p>Aqui, respeito e diversidade não são apenas palavras; são pilares que sustentam nossa jornada. Valorizamos as diferentes vozes e perspectivas da nossa equipe, pois acreditamos que a escuta ativa à pluralidade é a chave para a verdadeira inovação.</p>
<p>Como aprendizes eternos, estamos em busca de crescimento e evolução e, para isso, a colaboração é essencial. Juntos, construímos um ambiente em que o feedback é usado como uma ferramenta para o desenvolvimento mútuo e contínuo.</p>
<p>Com planejamento, agilidade e adaptabilidade, estamos prontos para mudar de direção sempre que necessário, sem perder o foco em fazer o nosso melhor.&nbsp;</p>
<p>E, claro, não podemos esquecer do nosso objetivo final: resultados excepcionais. Miramos alto e trabalhamos incansavelmente para alcançar o topo, celebrando cada conquista ao longo do caminho.</p>
<p><strong>Sobre o time:</strong></p>

<p>

</p>

<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><span><span>The Company</span></span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>Cerbo · OptiMantra</span> is a healthcare technology company built for the practices actively changing how medicine is delivered. Our platforms serve functional, integrative, direct primary care, concierge, med spa, and behavioral health practitioners who need software that keeps pace with how they work -- not the other way around.</p>
<p><br>Each platform is a purpose-built EHR and practice management solution. <span>Cerbo</span> is architected for clinical depth: deep configuration, protocol-specific workflows, and the kind of flexibility that holistic and functional medicine practices require. <span>OptiMantra</span> is structured for scale: multi-modality breadth, out-of-the-box readiness, and the operational infrastructure that growing practices rely on.</p>
<p><br>Together, our two platforms form a leading presence in this rapidly expanding market. Our practitioners are redefining what a patient experience can look like. We exist to give them the technology foundation to do exactly that -- at whatever size and pace they choose to grow.</p>
<p><br></p>
<p><span>What You'll Do&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><span>As a&nbsp;</span></span><span><span><span>Senior Product Manager</span></span></span><span><span>, supporting</span><span>&nbsp;</span><span>OptiMantra</span><span>,&nbsp;</span><span>you will own a major product area end to end—talking to users every week and shipping things that change how cl</span><span>inics&nbsp;</span><span>actual</span><span>ly run</span><span>. Healthcare software is stuck in 2005: providers drown in clicks while patients wait. You will help fix that, fast, with AI at the center. Small team, big problems, real autonomy. </span></span><span><span>Learn more about&nbsp;</span><span>OptiMantra</span><span>&nbsp;<span><a href="https://www.optimantra.com/about-us.html">here.</a></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><span><span>Primary Responsibilities</span></span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Own a product area end to end: roadmap, discovery, delivery, and iteration. No one hands you a spec.</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Ship&nbsp;</span><span>AI-first</span><span>&nbsp;features. AI Scribe is live today. Clinical decision support and intelligent workflows are next.</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Own the UX vision for your area.&nbsp;</span><span>OptiMantra</span><span>&nbsp;wins on clarity and guided experience. You&nbsp;</span><span>set</span><span>&nbsp;that bar.</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Talk to users constantly through discovery calls, usability sessions, and clinic visits—firsthand&nbsp;</span><span>signal</span><span>, not secondhand summaries.</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Prioritize strategically. More opportunities than bandwidth. You decide what to build, what to defer, and what to kill.</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>

<li><span><span>Coordinate cross-platform when features span&nbsp;</span><span>OptiMantra</span><span>&nbsp;and Cerbo (shared model, separate UX).</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>

<ul>
<li><span><span>Mentor Jr. PMs and collaborate with PMs across the organization.</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><span><span>Required Skills &amp; Qualifications</span></span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<ul>
<li><span><span>8+ years in product management, at least 2 at the senior level</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>EHR/EMR or healthcare software experience strongly encouraged—you should understand clinical workflows, not just software workflows</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Strong UX and UI sensibility: you evaluate designs critically, advocate for the end user, and know what good looks like</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Outcome-driven: you measure success by impact (retention, activation, clinical efficiency), not features shipped</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Strategic thinker who can connect product decisions to business outcomes and say no to&nbsp;</span><span>good ideas</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Comfortable with ambiguity and speed—small team, real autonomy, limited process</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>
<ul>
<li><span><span>Technically fluent: you hold your own with engineering on architecture, APIs, and tradeoffs</span></span><span>&nbsp;</span></li>
</ul>

<p>
