</p>

<div><p>Somos a <strong>Vitru Educação</strong>! 💜</p>
<p>A maior instituição privada de ensino EAD do Brasil e referência nacional do ensino presencial e Medicina. Juntos como <strong>Vitru, Unicesumar e Uniasselvi</strong>, nos dedicamos ao desenvolvimento individual e coletivo. Nossa prioridade é o aprendizado, fazemos do conhecimento um estilo de vida! Nós queremos continuar crescendo, com responsabilidade, mantendo a excelência e os valores que nos trouxeram até aqui e nos levarão adiante!</p>
<p>Quer vir conosco no <strong>Universo do Conhecimento? </strong>💜</p>
<p>Se quiser saber mais sobre a <strong>Vitru </strong>e suas marcas Unicesumar e Uniasselvi, acesse nosso site: <a href="https://www.vitru.com.br/">https://www.vitru.com.br/</a><a href="https://www.vitru.com.br/." title="https://www.vitru.com.br/.">.</a><br><br></p>
<p><strong>Título da vaga: Professor(a)-autor(a) | Curadoria e Validação de Conteúdo <span>- MLOPS: DEPLOY E MONITORAMENTO DE MODELOS&nbsp;- EdTech | Vitru</span></strong><br><br></p>
<p>A Vitru Educação está em busca de professor(a)-autor(a) para atuar na revisão técnica, validação acadêmica e curadoria conceitual da disciplina MICROSERVICES COM NODE.JS E MESSAGE BROKERS, do curso Desenvolvimento Backend com Node.js e NestJS, na modalidade pós-graduação EAD.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>SOBRE A ATIVIDADE:</strong><br><br>Nesta oportunidade, o conteúdo base é desenvolvido pela equipe interna, e o papel do(a) professor(a)-autor(a) é assegurar rigor teórico, atualidade científica e alinhamento pedagógico, contemplando:</p>
<p><strong>Curadoria e validação de conteúdo</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Revisão técnica de 3 temas (20 a 30 laudas cada)</li>
<li>Análise de atualidade conceitual, linguagem e adequação ao público</li>
<li>Conferência e eventual complementação de referências</li>
<li>Realização de ajustes diretamente no material (não apenas sugestões)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Atividades avaliativas e complementares</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Validação de 3 questões de autoestudo por tema</li>
<li>Revisão e validação de 15 questões objetivas por tema</li>
<li>Validação de materiais complementares (1 estudo de caso + 10 questões)</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Conteúdo audiovisual</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Validação de roteiros e gravação de 3 videoaulas (10 a 15 minutos cada)</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>EMENTA DA DISCIPLINA:<br></strong>Arquitetura de microsserviços com Node.js e NestJS. Uso do módulo NestJS Microservices. Comunicação síncrona e assíncrona entre serviços. Integração por meio de message brokers, com ênfase em RabbitMQ e Kafka. Aplicação de padrões de arquitetura distribuída. Resiliência, tolerância a falhas e escalabilidade. Introdução à observabilidade, monitoramento e estratégias de deploy de aplicações backend em ambientes de nuvem.<br><br></p>
<p><strong>REQUISITOS:<br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Pós-graduação lato ou stricto sensu – Especialização, Mestrado ou Doutorado na área da disciplina*.</li>
<li>Familiaridade com Google Docs e/ou Word.</li>
<li>Organização, gestão de prazos e clareza na escrita.</li>
<li>Experiência prévia na produção de livros ou materiais educacionais será considerada um diferencial.</li>
<li>Desenvolvimento Backend com Node.js e NestJS.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>VANTAGENS DE SER PROFESSOR(A)-AUTOR(A) VITRU:&nbsp;<br></strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Atividade 100% home office;</li>
<li>Acompanhamento especializado durante todas as etapas;</li>
<li>Publicações com registro de ISBN;</li>
<li>Desenvolvimento de competências autorais digitais;</li>
<li>Visibilidade nacional e reconhecimento acadêmico.</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>NOSSO PROCESSO DE SELEÇÃO:&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>O processo seletivo ocorre diretamente na plataforma InHire e segue as seguintes etapas:</p>
<ol>
<li>Análise do Perfil: avaliação do currículo e das informações cadastradas na plataforma.</li>
<li>Perguntas: os candidatos pré-selecionados receberão algumas perguntas para conhecermos melhor o perfil acadêmico e a experiência profissional.</li>
<li>Envio da Proposta: os candidatos aprovados nesta etapa recebem os detalhes da proposta (escopo, prazos, valores). O aceite não configura contratação imediata.</li>
<li>Contratação: a equipe de Contratos e Pagamentos solicita documentos, formaliza o contrato e direciona o professor(a) para os times de Arquitetos de Aprendizagem e Audiovisual.&nbsp;</li>
</ol>
<p><strong>Importante: A Vitru valoriza e apoia a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Todas as candidaturas são bem-vindas.</strong></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vitru-educacao-professor-a-autor-a-curadoria-e-validacao-de-conteudo-microservices-com-node-js-e-message">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/vitru-educacao-professor-a-autor-a-curadoria-e-validacao-de-conteudo-microservices-com-node-js-e-message</a></p>

<p></p>
<h1>Fully Remote Customer Support, Order Management, and Social Media Manager for E-Commerce Brand</h1>
<p><strong>Company:</strong> Select Saunas (selectsaunas.com)<br><strong>Location:</strong> Fully remote (must be based in the United States or Canada, )<br><strong>Type:</strong> Full-time<br><strong>Compensation:</strong> $40,000 + performance bonuses</p>
<hr>
<h2>About the role</h2>
<p>Do you want&nbsp;to help people become the healthiest version of themselves?</p>
<p>Select Saunas is a high-ticket online-only retailer of premium saunas. Our customers make considered, high-value purchases, and the experience we give them before, during, and after the sale is what sets us apart.</p>
<p>We're looking for a <strong>Customer Support and Order Management Specialist</strong>&nbsp;to own the order journey end to end: placing orders with our suppliers, keeping customers informed proactively, and resolving issues with the kind of white-glove care a high-ticket purchase deserves. You'll be the voice of the brand on email and phone, and the person who makes sure every order is accurate, on track, and delivered without surprises.</p>
<p>This is an ideal role for someone who is organized, calm under pressure, and genuinely enjoys helping people, not just clearing a queue. A welcome bonus is a genuine interest in saunas and health and wellness!</p>
<ul>
<li>
<div>Join the early stages of a fast-growing company</div>
</li>
<li>
<div>Be part of a small, fun, driven team</div>
</li>
<li>
<div>This is a long-term position with the opportunity to move into a customer support team manager</div>
</li>
<li>
<div>No limits on your advancement</div>
</li>
<li>
<div>Act without being micromanaged</div>
</li>
<li>
<div>Responsible Unlimited PTO (of course, and we won't disturb you)</div>
</li>
<li>
<div>Work from home and be an entrepreneur inside the company (without the risk of going alone)</div>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>What you'll do</h2>
<ul>
<li><strong>Handle inbound contact.</strong> Respond to customer emails and phone calls promptly and professionally.</li>
<li><strong>Place and manage supplier orders.</strong> Submit orders accurately to our suppliers, confirm details, and follow them through to fulfillment.</li>
<li><strong>Assign and communicate tracking.</strong> Add tracking numbers to orders and keep customers updated on shipment status.</li>
<li><strong>Reach out proactively.</strong> Contact customers about their orders before they have to ask — confirmations, delays, delivery scheduling, and follow-ups.</li>
<li><strong>Resolve complaints and issues.</strong> Coordinate with customers, couriers, and suppliers to manage freight damage, delays, returns, and any problems with empathy and a focus on a fair, fast resolution.</li>
<li><strong>Keep records clean.</strong> Maintain accurate order, customer, and communication records.</li>
<li><strong>Manage social media accounts. </strong>Light social media work - create posts showcasing customer saunas, manage the odd comment and DM...</li>
</ul>
<h2>What we're looking for</h2>
<ul>
<li>1 to 3+ years in ecommerce customer support, order management, or a similar operations role</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal English communication</li>
<li>Comfortable on the phone with customers, including pre-sale conversations</li>
<li>Strong attention to detail (accuracy on high-value orders is critical)</li>
<li>Self-directed and reliable in a fully remote environment</li>
<li>Comfortable learning and working in our order/helpdesk tools including Shopify and Gorgias</li>
</ul>
<h3>Nice to have</h3>
<ul>
<li>Experience with eCommerce</li>
<li>Familiarity with Shopify and common helpdesk/order tools (e.g. Gorgias, Zendesk, Shopify)</li>
<li>Experience coordinating with suppliers or freight/LTL carriers</li>
<li>A genuine interest in saunas!</li>
</ul>
<h2>Compensation &amp; structure</h2>
<p><strong>Base salary:</strong> $40,000/year.</p>
<p><strong>Performance bonuses:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Quality and accuracy bonus</strong> tied to customer satisfaction and response-time targets, and maintaining a low order-error rate. Compensation will naturally grow with increased experience and time.</li>
</ul>
<h2>Requirements</h2>
<p></p>
<div>
<ul>
<li>Internet: Fast, stable connection.</li>
<li>Work Environment: Be able to answer the phone quickly at any time during business hours. No loud background noise - no <em>loud</em> coffee shops, etc.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<h2>How to apply</h2>
<p>Send an email with the subject "<em>Your</em> <em>Name</em> - CSR Application" to <strong><a href="mailto:christoffer@selectsaunas.com">christoffer@selectsaunas.com</a>.</strong> The email should include your resume, a Vocaroo voice note under two minutes introducing yourself, letting us know why you're a great fit for this role, and mentioning your previous relevant experience.</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/select-saunas-customer-support-specialist">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/select-saunas-customer-support-specialist</a></p>
</description>

<p><strong>Remote — United States Only</strong><br><strong>Full-Time | 40 Hours/Week</strong><br><strong>Hourly Rate:</strong> $30-$40/hour, depending on experience<br><strong>Benefits:</strong> Medical and dental benefits available<br><strong>Reports To:</strong> COO</p>
<h3>About the Role</h3>
<p>Vista Fulfillment Group is hiring a full-time <strong>Customer Support Operations Manager</strong> to lead our customer support team and improve the systems, workflows, and response times behind our customer service operation.</p>
<p>This is a remote position open to candidates located anywhere in the United States. The schedule is a standard 40-hour work week, Monday through Friday, with availability required during business hours from <strong>9:00 AM to 5:00 PM</strong>.</p>
<p>This role is responsible for managing a team of approximately 10 customer support agents who handle customer tickets, refunds, disputes, order issues, phone support, email support, and Intercom chat support.</p>
<p>We are looking for a hands-on CS leader who can both manage people and improve systems. The ideal candidate must have strong experience with <strong>Intercom</strong>, including inbox management, reporting, routing, workflows, automations, and help center structure. They must also have strong experience with <strong>Fin AI</strong>, Intercom's AI agent, including setup, flow design, automation planning, content structure, and implementation.</p>
<p>Our current first response time averages around 48 hours. A major goal of this role is to reduce first response time to <strong>12 hours ideally, and no later than 24 hours</strong>, while improving ticket quality, accountability, and SLA performance.</p>
<p></p>
<h3>Preferred Experience</h3>
<p>Experience implementing Fin AI from the ground up or rescuing a failed AI support implementation.</p>
<p>Experience in ecommerce, fulfillment, logistics, retail, marketplaces, alcohol, or order-management support environments.</p>
<p>Experience handling refund, dispute, chargeback, delivery issue, and customer complaint workflows.</p>
<p>Experience creating CS dashboards, weekly KPI reports, SOPs, internal playbooks, and quality assurance scorecards.</p>
<p>Experience working with technical teams to improve integrations, reporting, AI workflows, and automation logic.</p>
<h3>Ideal Candidate</h3>
<p>The ideal candidate is a hands-on customer support operator who can manage a team, improve accountability, and personally help build a better Intercom and Fin AI support system.</p>
<p>This person should not only understand customer service management, but also know how to structure support workflows, build automations, analyze ticket data, and use AI to reduce manual workload without sacrificing service quality.</p>
<p>We are looking for someone who can take a support department with a 48-hour average first response time and build the systems, team discipline, and automation needed to bring that down to 12-24 hours.</p>
<p></p>
<h3>Location</h3>
<p>Remote, United States only.</p>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<h3>Key Responsibilities</h3>
<ul><li>Lead and manage a customer support team of approximately 10 agents handling tickets, refunds, disputes, order issues, chat, email, and phone support.</li></ul>
<ul>
<li>Monitor daily support performance, ticket queues, backlog, response times, resolution times, SLA compliance, quality standards, and agent productivity.</li>
<li>Reduce average first response time from approximately 24 hours to 12 hours ideally, and no later than 24 hours.</li>
<li>Build, improve, and manage Intercom workflows, routing rules, inbox structure, automations, tags, macros, reporting dashboards, team assignments, and escalation paths.</li>
<li>Lead the implementation of Fin AI, including flow design, AI response logic, help center content strategy, escalation rules, automation structure, and ongoing optimization.</li>
<li>Work with developers, consultants, or internal technical resources when needed to properly implement Fin AI, integrations, reporting, and automation improvements.</li>
<li>Analyze Intercom reports and support data to identify bottlenecks, agent performance issues, recurring customer problems, workflow gaps, and automation opportunities.</li>
<li>Create and maintain SOPs for ticket handling, refunds, disputes, escalations, SLA standards, phone support, chat support, and email support.</li>
<li>Train customer support agents on Intercom usage, Fin AI workflows, support quality expectations, communication standards, escalation procedures, and performance goals.</li>
<li>Review team performance and recommend staffing changes, coaching plans, disciplinary actions, promotions, or workflow adjustments to leadership.</li>
<li>Ensure support operations meet partner expectations and that SLA risks are identified and escalated quickly.</li>
<li>Work closely with the COO, operations team, fulfillment team, account management, and developers to improve customer experience and resolve recurring issues.</li>
</ul>
<p></p>
<h3>Required Qualifications</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Must be located in the United States.</strong></li>
<li>Bachelor's degree required.</li>
<li>Experience managing customer support teams of at least 10 people.</li>
<li>Minimum 3 years of hands-on Intercom experience.</li>
<li>Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Fin AI, Intercom's AI agent, including setup, flow design, automation, and optimization.</li>
<li>Strong understanding of customer support KPIs, including first response time, resolution time, backlog, SLA compliance, CSAT, escalation volume, ticket volume, productivity, and quality assurance.</li>
<li>Experience managing chat, email, and phone support teams.</li>
<li>Ability to build and improve Intercom workflows, inbox rules, routing logic, macros, reports, automations, help center content, and escalation processes.</li>
<li>Technical comfort with basic APIs, integrations, reporting exports, data analysis, and working with developers or consultants to complete support system improvements.</li>
<li>Strong leadership skills with the ability to coach, train, hold agents accountable, and recommend changes when needed.</li>
<li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills.</li>
<li>Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>This is a full-time hourly role with a rate of <strong>$30-$40/hour</strong>, depending on experience, leadership background, Intercom expertise, Fin AI implementation experience, and technical ability.</li>
<li>Medical and dental benefits are available.</li>
</ul>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5440/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://collectly.co">http://collectly.co</a>
</p>

<div class="content"><div class="section-wrapper page-full-width"><div class="section page-centered"><div>
<div><span><strong>About Collectly</strong></span></div>
<div>Collectly is a fast-growing healthcare technology company transforming revenue cycle management (RCM) through AI-driven automation. Millions of patients navigate inefficient billing systems every day, while providers face delayed payments, rising administrative burden, and operational complexity.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>Collectly applies artificial intelligence to automate workflows, accelerate cash flow, and modernize the patient financial experience; enabling healthcare organizations to operate more efficiently and focus on delivering care.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>There could not be a hotter space to play in.&nbsp; Healthcare is a $4.9T industry and is adopting AI technology at 2.2x the rate of the rest of the economy.&nbsp; RCM is at the heart of this transformation as it has a clear and demonstrable ROI to our customers.&nbsp;&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span><strong>The Opportunity</strong></span></div>
<div>We are hiring a <strong>Strategic Account Executive</strong> to drive high-impact enterprise revenue during a critical phase of growth.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>The role is focused on sourcing, developing, and closing complex six and seven figure deals with large healthcare organizations. You will own a defined set of strategic accounts and operate as a senior deal leader. The ideal candidate is capable of navigating complex buying committees, diagnosing deeply rooted revenue cycle challenges, and building compelling business cases that resonate at the executive level.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>This is not a transactional sales role. It is designed for a seller who thrives in long, consultative sales cycles, brings discipline to opportunity strategy, and can consistently win in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>You will partner closely with leadership, product, and marketing to expand our presence within large healthcare systems and deliver measureable value to the organizations we serve.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Key Responsibilities</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><h3>Lead Complex Deal Strategy:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Operate as the quarterback for complex, multi-threaded opportunities involving numerous stakeholders and decision makers.</li>
<li>Develop clear win strategies, champion maps, and executive alignment plans.</li>
<li>Navigate procurement, legal, security, and compliance processes typical within large healthcare organizations.</li>
<li>Maintain disciplined deal execution through structured opportunity planning and internal collaboration.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Elevate Discovery and Value Diagnosis:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Conduct high-quality discovery that surfaces operational challenges across the revenue cycle.</li>
<li>Diagnose workflow inefficiencies, patient billing friction, and revenue leakage that impact healthcare organizations.&nbsp;</li>
<li>Translate these insights into compelling ROI and operational improvement narratives that resonate with executive buyers.</li>
<li>Position Collectly as a strategic partner in improving the patient billing experience while helping healthcare organizations collect what they are owed.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Build and Maintain Strategic Pipeline:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of strategic opportunities through targeted outbound activity and account planning.</li>
<li>Partner with Sales Development and Marketing to penetrate priority healthcare systems.</li>
<li>Build multi-threaded engagement across clinical, operational, and financial stakeholders within targeted accounts.</li>
<li>Maintain disciplined opportunity management and accurate forecasting.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Operate with Precision and Accountability:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Maintain strong command of pipeline health, opportunity progression, and close plans.</li>
<li>Use data to evaluate deal momentum and identify risks early.</li>
<li>Collaborate closely with leadership to continuously refine strategic sales motion and execution.</li>
<li>Operate with a high degree of ownership over both individual performance and team success.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What Success Looks Like</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><h3>Within the first 90 days:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Develop a deep understanding of Collectly's platform, buyer personas, and healthcare revenue cycle workflows.</li>
<li>Build a clear strategic plan for their assigned territory and target accounts.</li>
<li>Establish strong internal alignment with product, marketing, and sales leadership.</li>
<li>Create early-stage pipeline within priority health systems.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Over two quarters, success includes:</h3>
<ul>
<li>Closing strategic six-figure opportunities.</li>
<li>Building a predictable pipeline of enterprise healthcare opportunities.</li>
<li>Developing strong executive relationships within large health systems.</li>
<li>Consistently progressing complex deals with clear strategy and momentum.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Qualifications</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><h3>Required</h3>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of B2B SaaS experience selling revenue cycle management technology or solutions within healthcare.</li>
<li>Demonstrated success closing 6-7 figure contracts in multi-stakeholder sales environments.</li>
<li>Proven ability to navigate complex healthcare buying processes including finance, IT, compliance, and procurement.</li>
<li>Strong enterprise sales methodology experience (MEDDPICC, Challenger, GAP selling, or similar).</li>
<li>Consistency in meeting or exceeding quota in strategic or enterprise sales roles.</li>
<li>Demonstrated ability to independently drive complex opportunities from discovery through close.</li>
<li><strong>Alignment with Collectly's GTM Values</strong>:
<ul>
<li><span>We are owners</span> - we have humility and put the team first.</li>
<li><span>We know our numbers</span> - we are data-driven and understand how to impact our business internally and our customers' business externally.</li>
<li><span>We are AI powered</span> - we automate easy repetitive tasks and research so we can solve harder problems and have a greater impact.</li>
<li><span>We are one with the Buffalo</span> - we expect that there will be challenges along the way and, like the Buffalo, we confront these challenges head on by running INTO the storm.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Core Competencies</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><ul>
<li>Deep expertise in enterprise qualification and deal strategy.</li>
<li>Strong discovery and diagnostic skills in complex operational environments.</li>
<li>Ability to build executive-level business cases that quantify financial and operational value.</li>
<li>Highly disciplined pipeline management and forecasting capabilities.</li>
<li>Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.</li>
<li>High ownership with strong internal collaboration.</li>
<li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environemtn.</li>
<li>Deep curiosity and a growth mindset.</li>
<li>Experience with a modern sales technology stack.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Preferred</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><ul>
<li>Experience selling directly into health systems, IDNs, or large healthcare provider organizations.</li>
<li>Background selling revenue cycle, patient financial experience, or healthcare workflow automation solutions.</li>
<li>Experience in early-stage or high-growth startup SaaS companies.</li>
<li>Familiarity with AI-driven or automation technology within healthcare operations.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>Why You'll Love It Here</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><ul>
<li><strong>Unlimited PTO:</strong> We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to recharge when you need it.</li>
<li><strong>Comprehensive Health Coverage: </strong>Fully paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for you and your dependents, because your well-being matters to us.</li>
<li><strong>Equity Opportunities:</strong> Share in our success with stock options - your hard work will drive our growth.</li>
<li><strong>Retirement Planning Made Easy: </strong>Enjoy a 401(k) with a generous company match to secure your future.</li>
<li><strong>Student Loan Support:</strong> We help lighten the load with contributions toward your student loans.</li>
<li><strong>Compensation Range:</strong> This role offers a competitive on-target earnings package with a strong base salary, uncapped commission, and meaningful equity - designed to reward top performers closing complex, high-value strategic deals.</li>
</ul>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>If you think you’re a “Buffalo” who has what it takes to have a meaningful impact within our rapidly growing organization and to the broader healthcare industry - apply to come join our team today!</div></div></div></div></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collectly-strategic-account-executive">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collectly-strategic-account-executive</a></p>
</description>

<p>We're looking for a Senior Content Marketer to join our SEO team, writing and optimizing content for a portfolio of B2B technology customers. This is a writing-first role — the majority of your time will be spent producing high-quality SEO content yourself — but you'll also bring strategic depth: diagnosing why content isn't performing, identifying opportunities in the competitive landscape, and translating data into action.</p>
<p>You'll work closely with a Head of Content on strategy direction while owning execution with a high degree of independence. You'll manage a small number of accounts end-to-end, occasionally oversee freelance writers, and lead performance reporting for your customers.</p>
<h2>What You'll Do</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Write gold-standard, hand-crafted content: flagship blogs, guides, and landing pages that demand deep research, original thinking, and editorial craft, aligned with search intent, customer strategy, and our highest quality standards</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Edit and elevate AI-generated content from our AI-assisted workflows to publication quality, and help teammates and freelancers do the same through clear feedback and example</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Partner with our AI implementation team to shape and improve AI content workflows, contributing editorial input, feedback, and real-world testing (you don't need to build the systems, but you help make them better)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Contribute to AEO work—including prompt tracking, citation monitoring, and AEO audits—to improve how customer content surfaces and gets cited across AI-powered search</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Diagnose content performance gaps using technical SEO analysis, competitive research, and content quality assessments, and recommend clear, prioritized improvements</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Refresh and optimize existing content to improve rankings, engagement, and visibility across both traditional search and AI-powered discovery tools</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stay current on how AI search tools (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Gemini, AI Overviews) surface and cite content, and factor this into content recommendations</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Own content execution for 3–4 customer accounts, managing quality, calendars, and deadlines with increasing independence</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Occasionally manage freelance writers on your accounts, providing clear briefs, feedback, and quality oversight</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Lead monthly performance reports for your customers, communicating results, insights, and strategic recommendations</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Join customer calls and build trusted relationships through clear communication and demonstrated expertise</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Collaborate with design on visuals and graphics that support your content deliverables</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Contribute to team knowledge-sharing and internal initiatives, including process improvements</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2>What We're Looking For</h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>4–6 years of experience in content marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS or an agency setting</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Exceptional writing ability: You produce publication-ready SEO content with minimal revision, writing clearly and persuasively across formats while adapting to different brand voices</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Deep SEO knowledge: You're fluent in keyword research, on-page optimization, content audits, and competitive analysis — and you know how to diagnose why a piece isn't ranking and what to do about it</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Emerging AEO fluency: You understand how AI-driven discovery tools are changing content visibility and are actively building hands-on skills in this space — prompt tracking, citation monitoring, AEO audits, and optimizing for AI Overviews</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Comfort working with AI content workflows: You can edit and elevate AI-generated content to publication quality, and you're eager to give input that helps shape and improve those workflows over time</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Analytical mindset: You interpret performance data (traffic, rankings, engagement) and use it to inform content decisions, not just report on them</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Familiarity with content and analytics tools such as GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Clearscope, or equivalents</p>

<li>
<p>AI fluency: You use AI tools to support your workflow responsibly and efficiently, and stay current on emerging best practices</p>

<li>
<p>Strong communication and remote collaboration skills; you build trust with customers through transparency and insight</p>

<li>

<li>
<p>Two Steps Ahead: We're proactive and strategic, solving problems before they become blockers.</p>

<li>
<p>Power Source, Not Power Trip: We lead through service, energizing teammates and customers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Pursue Mastery: We're always learning, evolving, and testing new approaches.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Left Brain, Right Brain, Robot Brain: Our best work blends creativity, analysis, and smart use of AI.</p>

<li>
<p>Lead your first performance reports with support</p>

<li>
<p>Contribute to team meetings and internal initiatives</p>

<p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p>

<ul>
<li>
<p>Own content execution and reporting for 3–4 customer accounts</p>

<li>
<p>Lead strategy refinements based on SEO data and customer feedback</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Demonstrate measurable improvements in content performance</p>

      <country></country>
      <state>North Carolina</state>
      <skills>Documentation, Technical Support, Technical Writing, Windows/Linux/MacOS, and Networking</skills>
      <category>Customer Support</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5429/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Asheville, NC
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://level.io">https://level.io</a>
</p>

<h1 class="h1-smaller margin-bottom-1-5rem"><span class="word"><span class="char">S</span><span class="char">u</span><span class="char">p</span><span class="char">p</span><span class="char">o</span><span class="char">r</span><span class="char">t</span></span>&nbsp;<span class="word"><span class="char">E</span><span class="char">n</span><span class="char">g</span><span class="char">i</span><span class="char">n</span><span class="char">e</span><span class="char">e</span><span class="char">r</span></span></h1>
<p><span class="word">We're building the future of RMM, and the people who deploy it for our customers are mission critical. This is not a traditional support role. You'll close hard tickets, onboard customers running thousands of endpoints, build automations that ship to everyone, and be the IT professional MSP owners trust on sight. If you want real ownership, real impact, and zero bureaucracy, you'll feel at home here.</span></p>
<div>
<h2 class="h3 margin-bottom-1-25rem"><strong>The opportunity</strong></h2>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<p class="paragraph-l margin-bottom-2rem">We're looking for a seasoned IT professional with 10+ years of real-world MSP or enterprise experience who can do all of this in a single week: close hard technical tickets, run a deep onboarding for a customer managing 1,000+ endpoints, build a reusable automation, record a platform how-to video, and flag a product bug to engineering with enough detail to reproduce it.<br><br>When sales closes a new customer, we want to say: "We're assigning you a dedicated IT professional with years of real-world experience who will learn your environment and personally help you deploy Level across your infrastructure." That's the bar. You're the kind of person MSP owners trust immediately.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2 class="h3 margin-bottom-1-25rem">What you'll own</h2>
<p class="paragraph-l margin-bottom-1rem"><strong>Tickets and triage</strong></p>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>Own the full inbound support queue, open to close. Respond to customer questions with clarity, speed, and empathy.</li>
<li>Diagnose whether an issue is a Level bug or a customer-side environment problem, and route it accordingly.</li>
<li>QA features before they reach production, catching issues before customers do.</li>
<li>Write up findings for engineering with enough detail to reproduce and fix.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p class="paragraph-l margin-bottom-1rem"><strong>Customer onboarding</strong></p>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>Meet newly signed customers to understand their infrastructure, team, and current workflows.</li>
<li>Learn their existing RMM setup and map it to how Level works.</li>
<li>Write custom automations tailored to each customer's environment as part of onboarding.</li>
<li>Train their team, from basics to advanced, until they're fully independent.</li>
<li>Own the post-sale relationship through onboarding and set customers up for the long term.</li>
<li>Think at scale: onboarding 1,000+ endpoint environments takes planning, staging, and precision.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p class="paragraph-l margin-bottom-1rem"><strong>Live support sessions</strong></p>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>Join scheduled video sessions, connect to the customer's Level account, and resolve issues live.</li>
<li>Be the face of Level technical support for customers who need more than a ticket reply.</li>
</ul>
</div>
<p class="paragraph-l margin-bottom-1rem"><strong>Automations and content</strong></p>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>Build reusable automations and contribute them to Level's library for every customer to use.</li>
<li>Record how-to videos for customers and our YouTube channel. Solid on-camera skills are a must.</li>
<li>Keep documentation accurate as the platform evolves.</li>
<li>Take on ad hoc projects: cleaning up the automation library, standardizing naming, auditing help content.</li>
<li>Help support our SOC 2 and ISO efforts. No prior experience needed, we'll train you.</li>
<li>Run community outreach across Discord and other channels. Keep members engaged and represent Level well.</li>
<li>Host regular office hours and product demos.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2 class="h3 margin-bottom-1-25rem">What you'll need</h2>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>10+ years hands-on as an MSP technician or internal IT pro who has run real environments at scale.</li>
<li>Deep experience with at least one major RMM platform, so you can speak the language of customers migrating to Level.</li>
<li>Strong Windows, macOS, and Linux skills. All three are required.</li>
<li>Strong scripting in PowerShell and Bash.</li>
<li>Experience managing 500+ endpoints; 1,000+ preferred.</li>
<li>Comfortable running customer-facing sessions: onboarding calls, training, live troubleshooting.</li>
<li>You think like a technician and a consultant, and you understand how IT departments actually operate.</li>
<li>Strong communication, written, verbal, and on camera. You'll write docs, record YouTube videos, host office hours, and represent Level to paying customers.</li>
<li>Self-directed and organized. You manage your own workload across competing priorities without a manager hovering.</li>
<li>Sharp diagnostic instincts. You know the difference between a platform bug and a misconfigured firewall.</li>
<li>You use AI tools heavily (Claude, ChatGPT, or whatever works) and know when the output is wrong and how to fix it.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2 class="h3 margin-bottom-1-25rem">Nice to have</h2>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>QA or software testing experience in a technical support context.</li>
<li>A background creating how-to video content or product documentation.</li>
<li>Familiarity with Level specifically.</li>
<li>Knowledge of compliance frameworks (SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001) relevant to MSP customers.</li>
<li>Familiarity with endpoint security tools (SentinelOne, CrowdStrike, and similar).</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2 class="h3 margin-bottom-1-25rem">Why you might want this</h2>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>Your work ships to everyone. The automations you build and the bugs your QA catches reach every Level customer.</li>
<li>Enormous ownership. You carry the customer relationship from the first onboarding call through full independence.</li>
<li>Direct access to founders. No layers, no bureaucracy.</li>
<li>We're profitable and growing. This isn't a company burning runway hoping for a miracle.</li>
<li>Room to grow as the company does.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2 class="h3 margin-bottom-1-25rem">Why you might not</h2>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li>We're a small team. There's no tier 1 to descalate to and no one to hand the hard tickets to.</li>
<li>You'll context-switch constantly. You might close a gnarly ticket in the morning, run a 1,000-endpoint onboarding call after lunch, and record a tutorial before you log off.</li>
<li>You're customer-facing and on camera. If live training and YouTube videos aren't your thing, this isn't the role.</li>
<li>We move fast and expect you to keep up.</li>
<li>We rely on async communication. You need to write clearly and work without waiting to be told what's next.</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div>
<h2 class="h3 margin-bottom-1-25rem">Details</h2>
<div class="margin-bottom-2rem">
<ul class="legal-list">
<li><strong>Hourly Rate:</strong>&nbsp;$30–40 per hour, depending on experience</li>
<li><strong>Location:</strong>&nbsp;Fully remote, work from anywhere.</li>
<li><strong>Schedule:</strong>&nbsp;Full-time (40 hours/week)</li>
<li><em>Occasional after-hours work may be required as needed to support customers.</em></li>
<li><strong>Apply:</strong>&nbsp;<a href="https://ask.level.io/r/supportengineer">https://ask.level.io/r/supportengineer</a></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/level-support-engineer">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/level-support-engineer</a></p>
</description>

<p>We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.<br><br>We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.<br><br>World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.</p><p></p><p>Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.</p><p></p><h2>About the role</h2><p>*<em>Open to hiring remote across the US — we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle</em></p><p>We are hiring a B2B Marketing Director to drive enterprise pipeline growth through demand generation, targeted account engagement, and experiential marketing. This role will own programs and campaigns that generate qualified pipeline and accelerate opportunities, partnering closely with sales to ensure marketing efforts translate into measurable revenue impact.</p><p>This person should be equally comfortable building digital campaigns, producing high-quality events, and optimizing conversion from lead to opportunity. This is not just a campaign execution role - we are looking for someone who thinks in terms of pipeline and ARR contribution.</p><p></p><h2>What you’ll do</h2><ul><li><p><strong>Enterprise Demand Generation:</strong> Develop and execute multi-channel campaigns that drive qualified enterprise leads and meetings. You’ll partner with sales to identify priority accounts and build targeted programs that convert interest into pipeline. You’ll build landing pages, nurture sequences, and conversion paths tailored to B2B buyers.</p></li><li><p><strong>Experiential and Field Marketing:</strong> Plan and execute strategic conferences, hosted events, and executive experiences designed to generate meetings and accelerate deals. You’ll optimize our event strategy to maximize qualified lead capture and pipeline creation. You’ll track event ROI based on meetings booked, opportunities influenced, and revenue contribution.</p></li><li><p><strong>Account-Based Marketing:</strong> Collaborate closely with sales leadership to align on ICP, target accounts, and messaging. You’ll support outbound sales motions with targeted campaigns and events that move accounts through the funnel.</p></li><li><p><strong>Pipeline and Funnel Optimization:</strong> Analyze lead-to-opportunity conversion rates, identify drop-offs, and recommend improvements. Ensure proper campaign tracking and attribution across digital and field efforts. Maintain reporting on pipeline contribution and campaign effectiveness.</p></li></ul><p></p><h2>What you’ll need</h2><ul><li><p>5+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, field marketing, or enterprise marketing</p></li><li><p>Demonstrated experience generating measurable pipeline from campaigns and events</p></li><li><p>Strong understanding of B2B funnels, lead lifecycle, and sales alignment</p></li><li><p>Experience working closely with sales teams and revenue leadership</p></li><li><p>Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools</p></li><li><p>Highly organized with a bias toward action in a fast-moving environment</p></li></ul><p></p><p>Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.</p><p>There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.</p><p>Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.</p><p></p><h3><strong>Working at Runway</strong></h3><p><a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kwmj4ato2kw&amp;ab_channel=Runway"><strong>Great things come from great teams.</strong></a><strong> We’d love to hear from you.</strong></p><p>We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.</p><p>More about Runway</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://runwayml.com/world-simulator.html">Universal World Simulator</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://runwayml.com/research/introducing-runway-gwm-1">GWM-1</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://runwayml.com/research/introducing-runway-gen-4.5">Gen-4.5</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://runwayml.com/research/introducing-general-world-models">General World Models</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://runwayml.com/research/introducing-runway-gwm-1#robotics-section">Robotics SDK</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://runwayml.com/research/introducing-runway-gwm-1#avatars-section">Conversational Real-time Agents</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://runwayml.com/studios">Runway Studios</a></p></li></ul><p>We're excited to be recognized as a best place to work: </p><p><a href="https://www.crainsnewyork.com/awards/best-places-work-2023">Crain's</a> | <a href="https://www.inhersight.com/companies/best/city/new-york-city-ny">InHerSight</a> | <a href="https://builtin.com/awards/new-york-city/2024/best-places-to-work">BuiltIn NYC</a> | <a href="https://www.inc.com/best-workplaces/2024">INC</a></p>

<div class="content"><div class="section-wrapper page-full-width"><div class="section page-centered"><div><span>Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more.       <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5403/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Berlin, Germany / Amsterdam, Netherlands / Hamburg / London, United Kingdom
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://insiderone.com">http://insiderone.com</a>
</p>

<div class="content"><div class="section-wrapper page-full-width"><div class="section page-centered"><div><span>Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.</span></div><div><br></div><div><b><span>About us</span></b></div><div><br></div><div><span>Insider One is the</span><b><span> #1 platform </span></b><span>that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and </span><b><span>become unstoppable.&nbsp;</span></b></div><div><br></div><div><span>Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered </span><b><span>by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices</span></b><span>.&nbsp; With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP),</span><b><span> Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels</span></b><span>, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.&nbsp;</span></div><div><br></div><div><span>We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry,</span><b><span> a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic</span></b><span>. We are backed by top-notch investors, including </span><b><span>Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst</span></b><span>, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.</span></div><div><br></div><div><span>Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only </span><b><span>woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns </span></b><span>in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, </span><b><span>we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader</span></b><span> in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it —</span><a href="https://www.gartner.com/reviews/market/multichannel-marketing-hubs/compare/product/braze-customer-engagement-platform-vs-insider-vs-salesforce-cloud"><span> see for yourself</span></a><span>. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and&nbsp;</span><a href="https://insiderone.com/insider-migration/"><span>the results speak for themselves</span></a><span>.</span></div><div><br></div><div><span>From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the</span><b><span> most socially progressive technology communities</span></b><span> in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like </span><i><span>100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables</span></i><span>, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.</span></div><div><br></div><div><span>Behind all these achievements is </span><b><span>an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers</span></b><span> that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.</span></div><div><br></div><div><br></div><div><strong>We are looking for a Product Manager who wants to make the dream a reality.</strong></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>What is our mission?</strong></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>We are visionaries who guide new product ideas. We are setting the vision for our growing family of products. We use data, research, strategy, and empathy to guide development and design teams toward a common goal since we believe that only our products can alter Insider One`s destiny. We are Insider One’s innovators, our impact starts on day one, and our mission is to prove that break-through products can be created outside Silicon Valley.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>What are we offering?</strong></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Impact</strong>; be a part of a world-class product team where we constantly get challenged with new things and the results of our actions create an impact for hundreds of millions of users every day.</div>
<div><strong>Personal Growth</strong>; work closely with experienced PMs, get mentored by some of the best people in their fields, join tons of different training like sales, design, customer communication. Develop the skills that you need to become a successful product manager.</div>
<div><strong>Experience</strong>; get important responsibilities, learn from your mistakes without getting blamed, watch experienced people work on complex matters, gain one of the most important things to become a great product manager, experience.</div>
<div><strong>Delight</strong>; make tough decisions, release new features, create innovating products which bring ease and joy to the life of many individuals who use them.</div>
<div><strong>Community</strong>; surround yourself with great people who constantly help each other and push each other to be better, join many different events, and become a part of the Insider One Community.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>What are we searching for?</strong></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Leadership</strong>, you can make decisions and set direction while motivating and inspiring people around you to follow you in that direction.</div>
<div><strong>Communication</strong>, you serve as the diplomat of the team, you can transmit complex information to different audiences clearly and you are talented in reaching the information you need on the people you are talking to.</div>
<div><strong>Problem Solving</strong>, you are a natural-born problem solver, finding solutions to complex problems motivates and excites you, and at that moment when you solve the problem, feeling that sense of accomplishment is worth all the effort.</div>
<div><strong>Teamwork</strong>, you are easily able to work with people around you, help them when they need, give or take constructive feedback, despite any personal conflict between you and them.&nbsp;</div>
<div><strong>Listening</strong>, despite the fact that communicating effectively is extremely important, you should also be able to gather information from many sources around you to help you make better-informed decisions on guiding and improving your products and services.</div>
<div><strong>Entrepreneurial Spirit</strong>, rather than waiting to adapt to change, you are actively seeking out change. You have a mindset that embraces critical questioning, innovation, and improvement. You can see the big picture, you are willing to take risks, you constantly seek new opportunities for innovation and you take ownership and pride in what you do. What are you going to do?</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What You Will Do</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><ul>
<li>Define the <em>why</em>, <em>when</em>, and <em>what</em> of the products our engineering team builds, leading cross-functional teams from ideation to launch.</li>
<li>Build a product and strategy that reflect <strong>Insider One’s vision</strong>, clearly articulating business value to align the team around each release.</li>
<li>Own and optimize the <strong>release process</strong>, coordinating all activities to bring products to market successfully.</li>
<li>Manage and prioritize initiatives, turning insights into actionable ideas by continuously tracking market trends, customer needs, and emerging technologies.</li>
<li>Define and analyze key <strong>product metrics</strong> to measure performance, customer satisfaction, and improvement opportunities.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What You Will Need</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><ul>
<li>A <strong>Bachelor’s degree</strong> from a top-tier university, preferably in Engineering, Business Management, or a related field.</li>
<li><strong>3+ years of Product Management experience</strong>, preferably with a <strong>B2B SaaS product</strong>.</li>
<li><strong>Hands-on experience in Agile Product Development</strong>.</li>
<li>Exceptional <strong>decision-making</strong> and <strong>communication</strong> skills.</li>
<li>The ability to <strong>manage complex initiatives</strong> with limited supervision.</li>
<li><strong>Fluent in English and Turkish</strong>, both written and verbal, as we have colleagues from all over the world.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div><h3>What We Offer</h3><div class="posting-requirements plain-list"><div><ul>
<li>Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together.</li>
<li>Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills.</li>
<li>Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru.</li>
<li>Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build.</li>
<li>Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses.</li>
<li>Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects.</li>
<li>From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories.</li>
<li>Get inspired by the greatest minds in the tech industry through events like our Tech &amp; Dev Talks.</li>
</ul></div></div></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div>We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.&nbsp;</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div>If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.</div><div><br></div><div><span>We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.</span></div><div><br></div><div><span>Please follow Insider One on </span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/insiderone/">LinkedIn</a><span>, </span><a href="https://www.instagram.com/insideronehq/">Instagram</a><span>, <a href="https://x.com/insideronehq">X</a>, <a href="https://www.facebook.com/insideronehq/">Facebook </a>and </span><a class="postings-link" href="https://medium.com/insiderengineering"><span>Medium</span></a><span>!</span></div></div><div class="section page-centered"><div class="text-small italic text-gray-700">We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.</div></div></div></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/insider-one-product-manager-b2b-saas-martech-europe">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/insider-one-product-manager-b2b-saas-martech-europe</a></p>

      <title>Toggl: Senior Product Manager</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <country></country>
      <state>Harjumaa (Tallinn)</state>
      <skills></skills>
      <category>Product</category>
      <type>Full-Time</type>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/7274/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Tallinn, Estonia
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://toggl.com/jobs/">https://toggl.com/jobs/</a>
</p>

<p>We are looking for a&nbsp;<strong>Senior Product Manager</strong>&nbsp;to join one of our&nbsp;<strong>Product Tribes</strong>, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You own your Tribe's direction, prioritization, and outcomes while working hands-on with design and engineering to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch&nbsp;<strong>Toggl Focus</strong>, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.</p>
<p>The salary for this position is&nbsp;<strong>€90,000 annually.</strong></p>
<p>You can work&nbsp;<strong>from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4.</strong></p>
<h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2>
<p>As a Senior Product Manager, you own a product area end-to-end: its direction, prioritization, and outcomes. You are accountable not for process, but for clarity, judgment, and results. You work hands-on with design, engineering, and revenue to identify the highest-value opportunities, shape effective solutions, and ship improvements that matter. You act as a player-coach, raising the quality of thinking, decision-making, and execution within your Tribe.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Your main responsibilities will be:</p>
<p><strong>Direction and prioritization</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Set clear direction for your Tribe.</strong>&nbsp;Define goals, translate company priorities into team focus, and identify the biggest opportunities and risks.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Make strong prioritization calls.</strong>&nbsp;Decide what to do and what not to do, sequence work sensibly, and keep low-value work out of the team.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Develop a strong point of view</strong>&nbsp;on your product area. Understand users, the market, and the business deeply enough to make tradeoffs and say no clearly, without escalating decisions unnecessarily.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Discovery and solution shaping</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Build real understanding of user problems</strong>&nbsp;through customer calls, support and sales input, user research, and data.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Shape solutions with design and engineering.</strong>&nbsp;Frame problems, compare options and constraints, and keep solutions tied to user and business value.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Hands-on leadership</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Lead designers within your Tribe.</strong>&nbsp;Guide prototyping, user testing, and UX quality as embedded builders, not through handoffs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Stay close to the work through execution.</strong>&nbsp;Review flows, experiments, metrics, and shipped output. Resolve ambiguity quickly. Help the team converge faster.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Coach your team</strong>&nbsp;by sharpening problem framing, improving decision quality, and keeping focus on the highest-value work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Metrics, learning, and communication</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Define success upfront</strong>&nbsp;for every initiative with clear OKRs, KPIs, leading indicators, and kill criteria. Measure impact after launch and decide whether to iterate, scale, or roll back.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Participate in roadmap reviews</strong>, sharing upcoming priorities with leadership and internal stakeholders and surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Explain direction and decisions simply.</strong>&nbsp;Keep stakeholders aligned with minimal overhead.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>AI as core leverage</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Use AI tools extensively in your daily work</strong>&nbsp;for research, synthesis, analysis, drafting, exploration, and prototyping, and set that expectation across your Tribe. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>About You</strong></h2>
<p>You will thrive in this role if you:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Have&nbsp;<strong>proven product management experience</strong>, ideally in B2B SaaS, or have built and shipped products people actually use, whether as a PM, founder, or in another role where you owned product decisions end to end.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Hold an&nbsp;<strong>extremely high bar for product quality.</strong>&nbsp;You've developed real craft in product development. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't be proud to put your name on.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have&nbsp;<strong>strong product judgment.</strong>&nbsp;You develop a clear point of view on your area, make grounded tradeoffs, and say no without needing permission.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are a&nbsp;<strong>problem-first thinker.</strong>&nbsp;You start from user needs and business impact, not from solutions or feature lists.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Can&nbsp;<strong>define and own outcomes rigorously.</strong>&nbsp;You set KPIs, run experiments, interpret data, and make tough calls based on results. You're accountable for whether the work matters, not just whether it gets done.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Thrive in ambiguity and move fast.</strong>&nbsp;You don't wait for perfect information or permission. You make confident decisions, adapt when new insights emerge, and course-correct without drama.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Can&nbsp;<strong>pick up a new domain fast.</strong>&nbsp;You're comfortable ramping into unfamiliar user segments and becoming the expert your Tribe needs.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have a&nbsp;<strong>strong understanding of product-led growth principles</strong>&nbsp;and know how to balance self-serve adoption with sales-assisted motions for larger accounts.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Are&nbsp;<strong>hands-on with AI tools.</strong>&nbsp;You actively use AI for research, analysis, drafting, and prototyping as a core part of how you work, not a side experiment.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Don't need to be managed.</strong>&nbsp;You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Have&nbsp;<strong>excellent written and verbal English communication skills.</strong>&nbsp;You explain direction and decisions simply, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and articulate customer value without jargon.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Value&nbsp;<strong>transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection.</strong>&nbsp;You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Nice to have: experience&nbsp;<strong>leading designers</strong>&nbsp;as embedded product builders, guiding user research, prototyping, and usability testing as part of an integrated discovery process, not as a separate handoff step.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2><strong>This Role Is NOT</strong></h2>
<ul>
<li>
<p>A meeting organizer, ticket router, or status reporter.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A layer between functions or a process owner whose main contribution is ceremony.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A roadmap administrator who writes detailed specs and manages backlogs rather than deeply understanding users and driving outcomes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A feature-factory role. If your primary metric is "stories shipped," this isn't the right fit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>The Team</strong></p>
<p>We are a global team of ~100 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.&nbsp;<a href="https://toggl.com/culture/">Our values</a>&nbsp;fuel our results.<br><br><strong>What's Happening at Toggl</strong></p>
<p>Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl Focus. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Benefits</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Unlimited sick leave</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)</p>
</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-product-manager-4">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-product-manager-4</a></p>
</description>

<p>

</p>

<p>Are you a talented Senior AI Engineer/Architect looking for a remote job that lets you show your skills and get decent compensation? Look no further than <a href="https://lemon.io/for-developers/?utm_source=weworkremotely&amp;utm_medium=job_ad&amp;utm_campaign=supply_en_ai_engineer/architect_jun_2026_job_ad">Lemon.io</a> — the marketplace that connects you with hand-picked startups in the US and Europe.</p>
<p><strong>What we offer:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>The rate depends on your skills and experience. We've already paid out over $11M to our engineers.</li>

      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0074/2689/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://automattic.com/">https://automattic.com/</a>
</p>

<p><a href="https://wpvip.com/">WordPress VIP</a>, the enterprise division of&nbsp;<a href="https://automattic.com/">Automattic</a>, is the world’s leading agile content management platform. Our suite of open solutions and services brings the ease and agility of&nbsp;<a href="https://wordpress.org/">WordPress</a>&nbsp;to the world’s largest enterprises. Our large and growing ecosystem of technologies, services, and integrations is designed to bring the freedom and power of open source to our customers, who include Meta, CNN, Salesforce, and hundreds more.</p>
<p>The Support Engineer role is responsible for providing advanced technical support to our enterprise customers, serving as an escalation point for complex issues that require deeper investigation. In this customer-facing role, you will handle challenging debugging scenarios, troubleshoot intricate application and platform issues, and help resolve problems that go beyond standard support workflows. You’ll work primarily through Zendesk tickets, collaborating closely with Support Engineers and Customer Success Engineers to ensure timely, high-quality resolutions while building your technical expertise and customer relationships.</p>
<p>You’ll serve as a technical resource for both customers and internal teams, bridging support and specialized engineering functions in high-impact situations. Support is provided 24/7, so scheduled weekday and weekend shifts, on-call rotations, as well as some holiday and evening availability, will be a requirement. Our customers are global and rely on our team to provide expedient support at any time of day.</p>
<p><strong>About You</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You are a technical problem-solver who thrives on helping customers. You may have a background in WordPress development, technical support, or agency work, and you’re ready to take on more complex challenges while continuing to build your engineering skills. You enjoy the variety of working with a wide spectrum of interesting global customers.</li>
<li>You never stop learning. You have a willingness to rapidly learn new technologies and deepen your expertise in areas like PHP, JavaScript, and the WordPress ecosystem. You’re excited by the challenge of debugging unfamiliar applications and expanding your technical toolkit.</li>
<li>You are curious and love to dig deeper. When an issue is escalated to you, you’re not satisfied with surface-level fixes. You’re driven to understand the root cause and to document what you learn, so the team can benefit from your investigation.</li>
<li><a href="https://automattic.com/creed/">Communication is our oxygen</a>&nbsp;and the basis of everything we do. You have excellent written English and can communicate technical concepts to customers and colleagues, even when things go wrong. You know how to translate complex debugging findings into clear, actionable guidance. You like actively solving problems, and helping others solve them too. You enjoy collaborative troubleshooting, whether that’s pairing with a Support Engineer on a tricky ticket, or consulting with a CSE on a deeper platform issue. Customer support, and what you learn solving customer problems, drive you.</li>
<li>You are passionate about customer success and team growth. You love working directly with customers and find satisfaction in mentoring teammates. Experience in a technical support environment—especially enterprise WordPress support—is highly valued.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Technical Requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>WordPress expertise with a solid understanding of core concepts,</strong>&nbsp;including themes, plugins, hooks and filters, WP-CLI, imports, and common troubleshooting patterns. Familiarity with the block editor (Gutenberg) and ecommerce solutions (WooCommerce) is a plus.</li>
<li><strong>Proficient in reading and troubleshooting code in multiple languages</strong>, including HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript. You should be comfortable navigating unfamiliar codebases to identify issues and able to write small code snippets or patches when needed.</li>
<li><strong>Understanding of web technologie</strong>s, including REST APIs, HTTP, DNS, domain management, and version control (primarily Git). Familiarity with reverse proxy configurations and caching layers is helpful but not required.</li>
<li><strong>Familiarity with software engineering practices</strong>, including coding standards, source control workflows, and basic testing concepts. Experience working alongside engineering teams or contributing to team repositories is valued.</li>
<li><strong>Solid understanding of performance and scalability concepts in WordPress environments</strong>, including common causes of slow queries, caching strategies, and resource optimization. Security awareness and familiarity with common vulnerabilities are welcome but not required.</li>
<li><strong>Comfortable using monitoring and debugging tools&nbsp;</strong>such as New Relic, Kibana, or similar platforms to investigate application behavior, identify errors, and trace performance issues.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Requirements</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>US-based position.</strong>&nbsp;Candidates must be based in the United States, undergo background checks as required, and hold American citizenship.</li>
<li><strong>Self-motivated and collaborative work ethic.</strong>&nbsp;Self-starters who love taking initiative and seeing things through to completion do well on our teams.&nbsp;</li>
<li><strong>Strong troubleshooting abilities.</strong>&nbsp;You can take complex problems and break them down systematically, identifying root causes through methodical investigation. You know how to gather the right information, isolate variables, and work toward resolution—or clearly document your findings when escalating.</li>
<li><strong>Experience in customer-facing technical roles.&nbsp;</strong>You’ve worked directly with customers in a support, agency, or consulting environment, and understand how to balance technical accuracy with clear, empathetic communication. Experience in enterprise WordPress support or a similar environment where customers expect fast, personal responses is an advantage.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What to Expect</strong></p>
<p>Your day-to-day work will include:</p>
<ul>
<li>Providing high-quality technical support and consultation through Zendesk tickets and customer calls.</li>
<li>Handling escalated customer issues that require deeper investigation, including urgent tickets and complex debugging scenarios.</li>
<li>In-depth debugging that requires close examination of logs, analysis of customer codebases, and collaboration with engineering teams.</li>
<li>Providing technical guidance to customers on WordPress best practices, performance optimization, and common implementation patterns.</li>
<li>Building and updating internal and customer-facing documentation.</li>
<li>Contributing to the continuous improvement of our platform, processes, and customer experience.</li>
</ul>
<p>Support is provided 24/7, so scheduled weekday and weekend shifts, as well as some holiday and evening availability, will be a requirement. There will be on-call rotations involving work with government contracts.</p>
<p><strong>Salary range:</strong>&nbsp;$55,000 to $85,000 USD – Please note that salary ranges are global, regardless of location, and we pay in local currency.</p>
<p>We are searching for high-caliber candidates with the skills and qualities to have a net positive for Automattic. Pay will reflect the potential contribution and the impact you can bring, which may, in some cases, go beyond the range stated.</p>
<p>We’re pleased to offer a straightforward, competitive base salary, providing financial clarity without complex variable components. This isn’t your typical work-from-home job: we are a fully-remote company with an open vacation policy. To see a full list of benefits by country, consult our&nbsp;<a href="https://automattic.com/benefits/">Benefits Page</a>. And check out these links to learn more about&nbsp;<a href="https://automattic.com/how-we-hire/">How We Hire</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://automattic.com/expectations/">What We Expect from Ourselves</a>.&nbsp;</p>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/automattic-support-engineer-wordpress-vip">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/automattic-support-engineer-wordpress-vip</a></p>
